entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Consumption: bonuses and penalties transferred between target and victim, Characteristic shifts, Recovery changes, body exchange and aging.
quotes: Add the magnitude of the effect to the target's Damage and Soak, and also add it to his Load.

entries.title: Incantation/Consumption guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Consumption: transferring wounds, illnesses, aging crises and Decrepitude from target to victim and placing the caster's soul in an object.
quotes: Permanently heal all of a target's wounds, killing a victim.

entries.title: Diablerie Guidelines
entries.summary: Defines what a supernatural creature is for Diablerie guidelines and states that Diablerie cannot affect the Divine.
quotes: Diablerie cannot affect the Divine.

entries.title: Debauchery/Diablerie guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Diablerie: dispelling, wards against creatures, perceiving Might, Arcane Connections, freeing bound demons, and creating Infernal auras and regiones.
quotes: Create an Infernal aura at level 1. Each additional magnitude increases it by one, to a maximum of 5.

entries.title: Incantation/Diablerie guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Diablerie: Magic Resistance, restoring a demon's Might, compelling and dominating creatures, False Powers and tainting vis.
quotes: Give a person, object, or area Magic Resistance equal to the level of the effect + 5, which does not add to other forms of resistance.
Permanently taint vis with the power of the Infernal, producing vis infesta.

entries.title: Effusion Guidelines
entries.summary: Notes that unnatural Effusion effects usually add two magnitudes to the level.
quotes: usually add two additional magnitudes to the level

entries.title: Debauchery/Effusion guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Effusion: softening objects, hotter flames, igniting materials of differing flammability, controlling natural phenomena of increasing severity and warding against them.
quotes: Soften an object, giving it a penalty to Damage or Protection equal to the effect's magnitude.

entries.title: Incantation/Effusion guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Effusion: hardening objects, chilling, controlling substances, moving and teleporting objects over increasing distances and storing a maleficium in an object.
quotes: Harden an object, giving it a bonus to Damage or Protection equal to the effect's magnitude.
Instantly transport an object to anywhere the caster has been before, or to which he has an Arcane Connection.

entries.title: Debauchery/Malediction guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Malediction: hampering, fatigue loss, wounds of increasing severity, destroying targets, disease and striking dead.
quotes: Strike a person or animal dead.

entries.title: Incantation/Malediction guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Malediction: roll penalties with extra botch dice, Characteristic reduction, and suppressing Virtues or granting Flaws.
quotes: Give a target a penalty on all die rolls equal to the magnitude of the effect, as well as that many additional botch dice any time the target rolls a 0.

entries.title: Phantasm Guidelines
entries.summary: General modifiers for phantasms: extra magnitudes for intricate or mobile phantasms and for turning animate things into inanimate ones, plus size modifiers when changing shape.
quotes: adds two magnitudes

entries.title: Debauchery/Phantasm guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Phantasm: dangerous phantasms, granting abilities to a target, invisibility, creating phantasms with Infernal Might and separating a spirit from its body.
quotes: Create a dangerous phantasm, like fire or poison, that does +(base level of the spell) Damage upon contact.

entries.title: Incantation/Phantasm guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Phantasm: remote senses, perceiving spirits, seeing through Infernal illusions and ominous visions of the past or future of increasing range.
quotes: Gain an ominous vision of an event that happened within a day in the past, or that is likely to happen within a day in the future.

entries.title: Debauchery/Psychomachia guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Psychomachia: tarnishing auras, changing emotions, shifting Personality Traits, granting temporary Traits, Warping Points and Confidence.
quotes: Increase or decrease a character's Personality Trait by one step, to a maximum of +3 or –3.

entries.title: Incantation/Psychomachia guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Psychomachia: sensing Divine or Infernal effects and emotions, implanting thoughts and desires, compelling behaviour and controlling a mind completely.
quotes: Compel a target to act on his immediate desires.

entries.title: Creo Corpus Healing Rules
entries.summary: Rules for healing with magic: only a Momentary Duration Ritual heals permanently, otherwise the healing is suspended and wounds return; healing a wound level also heals lesser ones; wounds and diseases need separate spells; Fatigue cannot be restored; physical Characteristics can be improved.
quotes: a healing spell cast other than as a Momentary Duration Ritual actually suspends the healing process so that, upon the spell's expiration, wounds are as fresh as they were when the spell was cast.
No Hermetic spell can restore Fatigue levels.
a spell to heal wounds cannot cure diseases, no matter how high its level, and vice versa.

entries.title: Medical Magic
entries.summary: Clarifies how existing Corpus spells from the core book behave under the new disease rules, and notes what Rego Corpus can and cannot do to mimic symptoms.
quotes: adds +3 to the Prognosis total if the follow-up treatment is designed by the character
Rego Corpus cannot inflict Disease Penalties, nor cause pain

entries.title: New Creo Corpus Guidelines (Disease)
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for curing diseases by their category, from Minor up to any disease.
quotes: Cure a Minor disease
Cure a Critical disease
Cure any disease

entries.title: New Perdo Corpus Guidelines (Disease)
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for inflicting diseases, limited by disease category and Severity at lower levels.
quotes: Inflict a Minor or Serious disease with a maximum Severity 10
Inflict any disease

entries.title: New Rego Corpus Guidelines (Disease)
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for inducing a minor or major symptom of a disease without causing the underlying illness.
quotes: Invoke a minor symptom of a disease without creating any underlying malaise
Invoke a major symptom of a disease without creating any underlying malaise

entries.title: Chirurgical Magic
entries.summary: Explains how Creo Corpus can duplicate the benefits of first aid and childbirth help, and how Rego Corpus can mimic surgery using an Intelligence + Finesse roll against the mundane Ease Factor plus a modifier.
quotes: Intelligence + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor equal to (Ease Factor for the mundane surgeon + 3)
Magical surgery involves no cutting

entries.title: New Creo Corpus Guidelines (Chirurgical)
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for treating wounds as less serious for activity purposes and for granting bonuses to childbirth rolls.
quotes: The target's wounds are treated as one category less serious for the purposes of activities while injured
Give a character a +6 to childbirth rolls

entries.title: New Rego Corpus Guidelines (Surgery)
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for performing magical surgical procedures of graded severity, which inflict or prevent worsening of wounds of matching category.
quotes: Perform a trivial surgical procedure (inflicting a fatigue level)
Perform a life-saving surgical procedure, preventing an Incapacitating or Fatal Wound from worsening

entries.title: Pharmacy Magic
entries.summary: How Creo, Intellego and Rego Craft magic can stock an apothecary's store, speed the search for ingredients, or duplicate the preparation of ingredients.
quotes: then the Ease Factor of searching for ingredients is reduced by 3
such spells require an Intelligence + Finesse roll equal to the Ease Factor + 6

entries.title: Finesse in Artistic Magic
entries.summary: Introduces using Finesse to add detail to created objects and illusions that magic otherwise fills in from the Form, and notes that the product carries the magus's sigil.

entries.title: Creating Objects with Creo Magic
entries.summary: Explains that Creo makes a functional natural object automatically, with an optional Intelligence + Finesse roll to add detail, and that artificial objects need the same Finesse as Rego.
quotes: The magus may use an Intelligence + Finesse roll to add detail, making the creation particularly beautiful or suited to a task.

entries.title: Crafting Objects with Rego Magic
entries.summary: Gives the Finesse Ease Factor for doing with Rego what a mundane artist could do with tools, adjusted by how long the mundane work would take.
quotes: The Finesse roll required is three more than the Ease Factor the mundane craftsman would have to make.
To do what a mundane artist could do in a season adds +6 to the Ease Factor.

entries.title: Flourishes
entries.summary: Lets artistic magi vary their sigil with cosmetic flourishes by concentrating, at a cost to the Finesse roll's Ease Factor.
quotes: Attempting to create a flourish adds 3 to the Ease Factor for the spell's Intelligence + Finesse roll.

entries.title: Crafting Items Using Rego Magic (Spell Levels by Material)
entries.summary: A table of base spell levels for Rego spells that make Individual-size items from raw materials at Personal Range and Momentary Duration.
quotes: These levels are correct for all spells that make items of Individual size, at Personal Range, with Momentary Duration.

entries.title: Ease Factors for Creating and Crafting Objects
entries.summary: A table of Finesse Ease Factors by artistic task difficulty, with notes on the included magic adjustment and when Creo magic needs a roll.
quotes: A character using Creo magic need not roll Finesse unless he desires the finished product to be of a quality higher than that represented by an Ease Factor of 9 on the following table.

entries.title: Level of Succes for Illusions
entries.summary: A scale of Finesse results that says how much control a magus has over the details of an illusion, including how convincing a copy of a particular person is.
quotes: The magus makes either a Perception + Finesse roll to copy something, or an Intelligence + Finesse roll to create an image without a model

entries.title: Finesse Bonuses and Penalties for Familiarity
entries.summary: Lists the modifiers to the Finesse roll for creating, crafting or simulating objects, depending on how familiar the magus is with the simile of the object.
quotes: The Finesse roll for using magic to create, craft, or simulate objects is adjusted by familiarity with the simile in the following ways.

entries.title: Magical Craft (Creo and Rego)
entries.summary: Rules for making natural and artificial things with magic: Creo creates natural objects directly, Rego rearranges materials like a craftsman, and a Finesse roll sets details and quality with Ease Factors based on mundane craft.
quotes: REGO CRAFT MAGIC ROLL: Perception + Finesse
CREO CRAFT MAGIC ROLL: Intelligence + Finesse
BASE EASE FACTOR: Highest Ease Factor for a Mundane Craftsman + 3

entries.title: Ease Factors for Creating and Crafting Objects
entries.summary: Table of crafting task difficulty with Ease Factors (including the adjustment for magic) from Trivial to Almost Impossible, with examples, for use with the Finesse craft rolls.

entries.title: New Craft Guidelines: Creo Animal and Rego Animal
entries.summary: New spell level guidelines for preserving a corpse (Creo Animal) and for manipulating, treating and processing items made of animal products (Rego Animal), with extra magnitudes for greater complexity.
quotes: Level 2: Preserve a corpse from decay.
Level 3: Treat and process items made of animal products.

entries.title: Creo Herbam Guidelines (Craft)
entries.summary: New Creo Herbam guideline for preserving a dead plant from decay.
quotes: Level 2: Preserve a dead plant from decay.

entries.title: Rego Herbam Guidelines (Craft)
entries.summary: New Rego Herbam guidelines for manipulating, treating and processing items made of plant products, with extra magnitudes for greater complexity.
quotes: Level 5: Treat and process items made of plant products.

entries.title: Rego Terram Guidelines (Craft)
entries.summary: New Rego Terram guideline for shaping dirt as a craftsman would, with extra magnitudes for harder materials and for complexity.
quotes: Level 2: Shape and form dirt, as if a craftsman had worked it.

entries.title: A New Breed of Craftsman (Rego Craft Magic and Finesse)
entries.summary: Explains that Rego Craft Magic items rely on the user's Finesse for quality and are harder than mundane craftsmanship, so specialists skilled in Finesse become valuable as magical tools spread.
quotes: the quality of the produced item is dependent on a Finesse roll against an Ease Factor that is always at least 3 points higher than that needed by a mundane craftsman

entries.title: Rego Craft Magic
entries.summary: Summary of how Rego magic can do the work of a craftsman: the magus supplies the raw materials, the Duration is normally Momentary, and a Finesse roll is made against an Ease Factor raised above the mundane craft roll, with further increases for compressing long work into an instant or for many intermediate steps.
quotes: Rego craft magic requires a Finesse roll, the Ease Factor for which is at least three higher than the Craft roll needed by a mundane craftsman making an equivalent object.
doing a month's work in an instant requires an additional +3; doing a season's work in an instant incurs a +6; and a year's work imposes a +9 to the Ease Factor

versions.title: Rego Craft Magic
versions.summary: Rules for using Rego to do a craftsman's work: matter cannot be created, a Finesse roll is needed against an Ease Factor at least 3 higher than the mundane craft, failure gives a mess and a botch a hidden flaw, long timespans raise the Ease Factor, and a table gives the minimum Ease Factor by task difficulty.
quotes: +3 for a month's work, +6 for a season's work, or +9 for a year's work
| Trivial | 0 | 3 |
| Almost Impossible | 24+ | 27+ |

entries.title: Shape and Material Bonuses for Scrying Devices
entries.summary: Defines scrying as Intellego at Arcane Connection Range, notes that the Code of Hermes uses the word more broadly, and collects the Shape and Material bonuses commonly used in clairvoyance and clairaudience devices (rock crystal, electrum, silver, mirrors).
quotes: Rock crystal is perhaps the most potent, granting +5 clairvoyance
they also grant a +6 bonus to effects that display images within the mirror

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.137
Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.52, 139

entries.title: Scrying Devices and the Code of Hermes
entries.summary: Explains how a twinned or room-targeting scrying device can cause its user to commit the High Crime of scrying on another magus, why zero Penetration avoids this, how Tribunals tend to treat entrapment, and why remote writing carries none of these risks.
quotes: Designing the device with a Penetration of zero prevents this, but also prevents distant communication between magi.
has committed a High Crime

entries.title: Scrying Devices and Penetration
entries.summary: Because the Oath forbids scrying on other magi, devices sold to mundanes should have no Penetration, which makes them useless for contacting magi; remote writing devices avoid the problem but spread permanent Arcane Connections.
quotes: any magus embarking on plans to distribute scrying devices to mundanes should design them with zero Penetration

entries.title: Optional Rule: Limits on Instant Transportation
entries.summary: An optional way to limit instant transportation: the traveller moves through every point between origin and destination, so needs an unobstructed path, and is stopped at the nearest barrier such as a closed door or shackles.
quotes: a character must have an unobstructed path between the two locations to use such spells

related.text: ArM5 p.134 Gift of Frog's Legs

entries.title: New Guidelines for Instant Transportation
entries.summary: New spell guidelines for instantly transporting animals, liquids, plants, fire and non-living objects short distances, with extra magnitudes to extend the distance up to travelling to an Arcane Connection.
quotes: In all cases, add 1 magnitude to increase the distance to 50 paces, 2 magnitudes for 500 paces, 3 magnitudes for 1 league, 4 magnitudes for seven leagues, and 5 magnitudes to a place for which you have an Arcane Connection.
Transport a non-living object instantly up to 5 paces.

entries.title: Instant Transportation and Requisites
entries.summary: Discusses whether instant transportation needs casting requisites: Rego Corpus moves what the body wears and carries, but a heavy burden or mixed materials justify a requisite, and the primary Form comes from the highest base level.
quotes: any Burden which causes an Encumbrance of 3 or more should require a requisite appropriate to the material comprising the majority of the weight

entries.title: Flying and Fast Travel Spells
entries.summary: Example flight and fast-travel effects that set out how speed, Finesse rolls to change direction, and Load limits work for a flying caster, rug, boat or wind form, including how a gale form can knock objects over.
quotes: this is reduced by one mile an hour for every point of Load he carries
Ease Factor 12 at moderate speed, Ease Factor 15 at maximum speed of forty miles an hour

entries.title: Hermes' Portal and Mercere's Portals Compared
entries.summary: Compares the Hermes' Portal ritual and the permanent Mercere's Portals with instant-transportation devices: portals need a pair of high-level castings or enchantments and cannot be redirected, but they carry any object and give no Warping to the traveller.
quotes: A Hermes' Portal requires two casters (or groups using Wizard's Communion) who can cast a 75th level Ritual spell, and it lasts just a year.
still constitute a 65th level enchantment

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.80, 100-101

entries.title: Appendix: Astrological Correspondences
entries.summary: Reference for astrological correspondences, including how to cast a Daily Horoscope or Nativity Horoscope with an Intelligence + Astronomy roll against Ease Factor 9.
quotes: Creating a Daily Horoscope takes one hour.
Creating a Nativity Horoscope takes a day's work.

entries.title: Signs by Category
entries.summary: Table giving each zodiac sign's element, humor, gender and temperament (cardinal, fixed, mutable).

entries.title: Signs and Decans
entries.summary: Table of the influence of each of the three decans of every zodiac sign.

entries.title: Astrological Houses
entries.summary: Table of the twelve astrological houses and the province each governs.

entries.title: Spheres of Influence of the Planets
entries.summary: Table of what each planet influences and which Characteristic it governs.
quotes: Influences rulership, kings, leadership, and authority, health, and well-being, and governs the characteristics Presence and Stamina.

entries.title: The 12 Astrological Houses
entries.summary: Explains the ascendant sign and how the circle of the Zodiac is mapped into twelve houses that shape how each sign influences the world.
quotes: The sign is known as the ascendant, and is the starting point of the horoscope.

entries.title: Scribal Magic and Replacing Crafts
entries.summary: Introduces magic for scribes and librarians and gives the rule that when Finesse and Rego replace a mundane craft, the target scores for quality of goods rise.
quotes: when using Finesse and the Art of Rego to replace skill at mundane crafts, the target scores representing levels of quality of goods increase by at least 3 points.

entries.title: Magically Copying a Single Page
entries.summary: Copying a page with magic is a two-stage process: one effect lays an image of the original over a blank page and a Rego craft effect makes the ink follow it, with an Intelligence + Finesse roll whose Ease Factor depends on the Quality of the book being copied.
quotes: The caster must make an Intelligence + Finesse roll to determine the accuracy of the spell's copying.
for a Quality of 7 to 9 the copying Ease Factor is 12, and for a Quality of 10 or more the Ease Factor is 15

related.text: Covenants p.97 The First Furrow Guides the Second

entries.title: Magically Copying an Entire Book
entries.summary: Gives the time a mundane scribe needs to copy a tractatus, summa or Bible, and explains that copying a whole book in one casting needs a very hard Finesse roll, so copying page by page is compared on a table of the caster's Finesse Total against the Quality retained.
quotes: would require an Intelligence + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 15, minimum
compare the Finesse Total (Intelligence + Finesse) of the caster on the nearby table to determine how much Quality is retained from the original book

entries.title: Quality Remaining After Copying
entries.summary: A table showing, for a given Finesse Total, how many pages are spoiled when a book is copied page by page with magic and how far the Quality of the copy falls below the original, with adjustments for easier or harder books.
quotes: This table assumes an Ease Factor of 12 (i.e. Quality 7 to 9), a simple die roll, and no proofreading.
For books requiring Finesse rolls of Ease Factor 9, add 3 to the Finesse Total; and subtract 3 for books requiring Finesse rolls of Ease Factor 15.

entries.title: Resonances and Binding of Copied Books
entries.summary: A book copied with magic loses any resonant materials or aura clarification of the original, though a new binding can add similar benefits; unbound books are easily damaged and cannot have resonances.
quotes: If such techniques have been used in the production of a book that is then copied with magic, the benefits of such resonances are lost.

entries.title: Proofreading Copies
entries.summary: Intellego Imaginem can compare a copy with its original to find differing places, though a person who understands the text must still check them; proofreading with such a device is far faster than writing.
quotes: a text that would normally take a season to write can be proofread and corrected in a week with unlimited uses of this spell

entries.title: Wizard's Communion (Group Casting)
entries.summary: Lets several magi pool power to cast one spell: limits on participants, the combined level needed, the reduced target number for the caster, extra botch dice per participant, and shared Warping on a botch.
quotes: Only one extra magus may join the Communion for each 5 levels of the specified spell being cast.
the target number for the spellcasting roll is the spell's level divided by the number of magi participating in the Communion

entries.title: Forceless Casting
entries.summary: Option for a magus to cast a spell deliberately without Penetration so it cannot affect magi with Magic Resistance, useful in tournaments or large-area spells.
quotes: A magus can deliberately ensure the Penetration Total of a spell does not exceed 0.

versions.title: Forceless Casting
versions.summary: A magus can deliberately cap a wide-area spell's Penetration at zero so that it does not affect other magi with at least Magic Resistance zero, reducing but not eliminating the risk of criminally affecting others.
quotes: a magus can deliberately ensure the Penetration of a spell never exceeds '0'

entries.title: Magic in Other Languages
entries.summary: Casting without Latin incurs the penalty for not using the voice; integrating another language into Hermetic magic is done through a research project aiming for Discoveries, at a lower breakthrough cost and without Warping.
quotes: they suffer a penalty to their casting totals, just as if they were not incorporating their voice at all
requiring only 15 breakthrough points to achieve

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages (original research)

entries.title: Cantations
entries.summary: Cantations are low-level formulaic spells taught to child apprentices; an apprentice can learn many in a season, and being formulaic they are cast even when the casting total falls somewhat short of the spell level.
quotes: In a single season, an apprentice can learn a number of spells equal to her parens' highest applicable Lab Total
the spell casting total needs to fall short of the spell level by 10 or more to fail

entries.title: Optional Rule: Learning Cantations in Play
entries.summary: Optional rule letting a player turn a spontaneous spell the character has cast repeatedly in play into a formulaic spell by spending adventure experience points, at a cost based on the spell level.
quotes: He must use the same spell repeatedly, at least as many times as the level of the spell.
The level of the spell determines its cost, at one experience point per level.

entries.title: Casting Tablets
entries.summary: Sidebar summarizing how any magus casts a spell from a casting tablet: a fixed Casting Total with no variation or vis boost, with Fatigue losses and Warping increasing the more the Spell Level exceeds the total.
quotes: Generate a Casting Total as if the magus knew the formulaic spell or ritual, and remember to include Wound and Aura Penalties.
If the Spell Level is up to 10 levels greater than the Casting Total, the spell is still cast, but the magus loses two Fatigue levels.

entries.title: Creo Aethera Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for creating aether at each density from intangible up to metal, with an extra magnitude for unusual or worked shapes.
quotes: Creating that aether in some unusual or worked shape is one magnitude higher than the listed values.

entries.title: Intellego Aethera Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for sensing aether, whether free or within other material, perceiving its unnatural properties, and speaking with aetheric spirits, creatures and plants; they are unaffected by aether density.
quotes: Intellego Aethera spells are not affected by the density of the aether.

entries.title: Muto Aethera Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for giving aether new properties and sensory species, changing its speed, and transmuting it into elemental, living or intangible Forms, with extra magnitudes for denser aether.
quotes: Add successive magnitudes for aether with densities of fire, air, water, earth, stone, and metal.

entries.title: Perdo Aethera Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for destroying a property of aether, a quantity of free aether, or aether contained in other material, with extra magnitudes for denser aether.
quotes: Perdo Aethera spells may be used to destroy an amount of aether.

entries.title: Rego Aethera Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for warding against aether, changing its density and moving it, with magnitude adjustments based on the highest density involved.
quotes: Magnitude adjustments are required based on the highest density.

entries.title: Certamen Reputations
entries.summary: A table for learning information about a rival duelist by rolling a die plus Reputation, with modifiers when the characters share a school, Tribunal or House, giving results from etiquette scandals up to famous victories.
quotes: A character encountering another duelist may roll on the following table to determine information about their potential foe:
Both members of House Tremere +3

entries.title: Dueling (Certamen Etiquette and Duels for Love)
entries.summary: Explains the social role of certamen among Tremere, including leaders dueling for their sides, 'for love' duels fought without vis, and the etiquette factors that affect a duelist's reputation.
quotes: Vis is not used when fighting for love, even with non-Tremere magi.

entries.title: Styles of Certamen (Schools)
entries.summary: Rules for certamen schools: a magus follows one school, may study a season with another to imitate its techniques, and chooses at the start of each duel whether to duel as a follower of a school or in a variety of styles.
quotes: At the start of each certamen, each combatant chooses if they are going to duel as a follower of their school or, alternatively, if they will duel in a variety of styles.

entries.title: Certamen School: Gladiator (Swordsman)
entries.summary: The balanced, simple School of the Swordsman, reflected in the basic certamen rules, with rumors of secret vis techniques that the Tremere deny.
quotes: The School of the Swordsman is the style of the Founder Tremere, reflected in the basic rules.

entries.title: Spells for Manipulating Auras
entries.summary: Discusses attempts to create or strengthen auras with Ritual magic, and rules that a Creo Vim structural enhancement to raise the aura score counts as creating a new preternatural tether.
quotes: a Creo Vim structural enhancement to increase the aura score by 1 point should be interpreted as creating a new preternatural tether of sufficient strength to increase the preternatural aura score by 1 point

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition p.100 Hermetic Architecture

entries.title: New Creo Vim Guideline (aura strengthening)
entries.summary: Spell guideline for Creo Vim effects that potentially strengthen a Magic aura by causing a roll on the Aura Strengthening Table modified by the effect's magnitude.
quotes: roll on the Aura Strengthening Table with a modifier equal to magnitude of the base effect

entries.title: New Intellego Vim Guideline (aura alignment)
entries.summary: Spell guideline for discerning the alignment of an aura.
quotes: Level 4: Discern the alignment of an aura.

entries.title: New Perdo Vim Guideline (aura weakening)
entries.summary: Spell guideline for Perdo Vim effects that potentially weaken a Magic aura by causing a roll on the Aura Weakening Table modified by the effect's magnitude.
quotes: roll on the Aura Weakening Table with a modifier equal to magnitude of the base effect

entries.title: Wards and Penetration
entries.summary: Explains that Hermetic warding spells must penetrate Magic Resistance, why high-level wards are impractical, and why Arcane Connections generally cannot boost Penetration for ward spells.
quotes: these wards must penetrate Magic Resistance to have their effect

entries.title: A Note on Boundary Effects
entries.summary: Points out that Boundary-range effects such as an Aegis of the Hearth or a ward cannot travel with a moving structure like a flying castle and are left behind.
quotes: Boundary effects are not, by their nature, mobile.

entries.title: Ritual Wards and Other Boundary Spells
entries.summary: How Ring, Circle and Boundary wards are cast around a walled magical island: tracing a Ring or Circle on foot is slow and risky, while Boundary spells are rituals that need vis but are easier and safer, and the Range, Duration and Target of a ward add a fixed number of levels to the level the caster chooses.
quotes: cannot move faster than 10 paces per round, and must make an Intelligence + Concentration roll of 6+ per round
A Ward's level is selected by the caster, but the Touch Range, Sun Duration and Boundary Target add 35 levels.

related.text: ArM5 p.112 Ring and Circle wards
ArM5 p.161 Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Using a Wall as a Spell Boundary
entries.summary: Three considerations when a large wall is the target of Boundary spells: they are rituals and so must be prepared in advance, some wards need a second marked boundary, and the size of the Boundary requires extra magnitudes as the area grows.
quotes: Boundary spells are Rituals, and Rituals cannot be cast spontaneously.
The basic Boundary is only 100 paces wide
a circular island with a diameter of 3 miles requires 2 added magnitudes, a 30 mile diameter island requires 3 added magnitudes, and a 300 mile wide island requires 4 added magnitudes

entries.title: Bellum
entries.summary: A game apprentices play by casting Ager Belli to make illusionary soldiers fight, decided by repeated Intelligence plus Finesse rolls judged by a peer, or by forcing the opponent to lose concentration with a second spell.
quotes: Each round, the participants make an Intelligence + Finesse + stress die roll.
Maintaining a spell while casting a second requires a Stamina + Concentration + stress die against an Ease Factor of 15.

entries.title: Spells to Determine Astrological Time
entries.summary: New Intellego Vim guidelines for measuring astrological time and conditions, used with Astrological Durations; they need no astrological Virtue.
quotes: Discern and measure a single astrological factor in the environment.
Discern and measure all astrological factors in the environment.

entries.title: Cosmology of the Spheres
entries.summary: Describes the nested celestial spheres, which of them (the elemental ones) Hermetic magic can affect, and why the lunar sphere and the ethereal spheres beyond it, made of unchanging aether, lie outside Hermetic Magic Theory until a breakthrough.
quotes: it cannot be affected by Hermetic magic

entries.title: Detecting the Gift
entries.summary: Sidebar giving the Intellego Vim guideline for detecting The Gift, its limits against the False Gift and Magic Resistance, and the warning that scrying on another magus is forbidden.
quotes: Intellego Vim spells can detect The Gift. The base level is 10

entries.title: Finesse
entries.summary: Arcane Ability for manipulating spells and performing special feats with them, such as positioning objects delicately or targeting spells.
quotes: You would use this Ability to position objects delicately or to target spells.

entries.title: Inanis (Optional Magical Pollution)
entries.summary: An optional rule for magical pollution: residue left when vis is imbued into objects can be gathered into pawns of inanis, which cancel magical effects of limited magnitude within a radius over time and drain Might from supernatural creatures that linger in its area.
quotes: One pawn of inanis takes one round to stop a first magnitude magical effect from working within one pace.
Supernatural creatures with a Might less than or equal to (5 x pawns) of inanis lose one Might for every season they spend within its area of effect.

entries.title: Magical Mechanical Power
entries.summary: An example enchantment that does the work of a draft animal by turning an axle, with the rule that each added magnitude multiplies its power output.
quotes: the Hermetic Generans can do as much work as a person or animal with a Strength of +5 (approximately one horse-power)
each magnitude added to the effect increases the power output ten-fold

entries.title: After the Arts Are Opened
entries.summary: Once Opened, an apprentice has score 0 in every Art, can cast spontaneous spells and read casting tablets with the right Abilities, and uses the standard magical formulas with current Arts.
quotes: Once the Arts are Opened, the apprentice character has a 0 in each of the five Techniques and ten Forms.

entries.title: Muto Corpus Shapechanging Rules
entries.summary: Rules for transforming people: the original form leaves traces, long stays in animal form change behaviour, the mind and knowledge stay intact, magi can cast in animal form with the no-hands-or-voice penalty, worn items need casting requisites, and foci allow the target to change back.
quotes: Magi can cast spells while in animal form, but they suffer the normal –15 penalty for casting without hands or voice.
Muto Corpus spells cannot alter a person's mind, so they leave the transformed person's intelligence and knowledge intact.

entries.title: New Summon and Command Spells
entries.summary: New Rego guidelines for controlling or summoning disembodied spirits by their own Form, plus the rule that Mentem or Animal spells can command spirits with Intelligence or Cunning.
quotes: Level 5: Control a disembodied spirit of (Form)
Level 15: Summon a disembodied spirit of (Form)

entries.title: Learning Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: How a character first learns a Supernatural Ability by Training or Teaching, with a Source Quality penalty equal to scores in other Supernatural Abilities and a larger penalty if the Hermetic Arts have been opened.
quotes: SUPERNATURAL ABILITY SOURCE QUALITY: Normal Source Quality - Total Score in Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Small Effects and High Penetration Bonuses (Subtle, Public and Wilderness Spells)
entries.summary: Describes the three categories of spells urban magi choose (subtle, public and wilderness), how Dominion and casting-style penalties apply to each, and why low-level subtle spells have good Penetration.
quotes: Most cities have a Divine aura of 3, which means that spellcasting rolls are penalized by –9.

related.text: ArM5 p.145 Aura of Ennobled Presence
ArM5 p.151 The Call to Slumber

entries.title: Aristotelian and Platonic Magic Theory breakthroughs
entries.requires: Troupe decision that the breakthrough exists; research by a magus
entries.summary: Optional saga-level rules for researching Aristotelian or Platonic Magic Theory as a Hermetic breakthrough, which Arts must be used in the experiments, and what the finished breakthrough adds to a magus's totals. A tractatus lets others incorporate it as a minor breakthrough.
quotes: would allow a magus character to add his score in Artes Liberales to his Lab Totals and his formulaic spell casting totals

related.text: ArM5 Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 (original research)

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Ancient Magic
entries.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
entries.summary: Overview of how a magus can fold a pre-Hermetic tradition into Hermetic theory without fully synthesizing it, possibly bending or breaking the limits of magic.
quotes: Hermetic magic is versatile enough to integrate many of the principles of these magics

entries.title: Historical Settings
entries.summary: Optional guidance for running a saga set in an earlier era when these traditions still have living practitioners, with the troupe filling in missing hedge-magic details.
quotes: You will need to fill in a few rule details

entries.title: Integration and Original Research
entries.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
entries.summary: Explains how integration compares with original research and that breakthrough points from both approaches can be added together toward a single Breakthrough.
quotes: breakthrough points from integration may be added to breakthrough points from original research

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages (original research)

entries.title: Hyperborean breakthroughs (integration targets)
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
entries.summary: The minimum breakthrough points required to integrate each aspect of Hyperborean magic (a new Duration, spirit-travel, vis-less permanent magic and enchantment, removing shape, material and size limits, and Ritual effect enchantment), with advice to vary the totals slightly.
quotes: Integrating Vis-less Permanent Magic: 70 breakthrough points
Integrating a New Duration (Minor Breakthrough): 30 breakthrough points

related.text: Ancient Magic Introduction: Hermetic breakthroughs and Insight

entries.title: Hyperborean Integration Process
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
entries.summary: The five-step process for integrating Hyperborean magic: find a source, gain Insight, incorporate it into a matching effect, research as in the Introduction, and consider the consequences. Each source gives one Insight tied to its most significant Power.
quotes: Each source allows your character to gain one Insight, which permits him to create one specific effect.

entries.title: Hyperborean Insight
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
entries.summary: Modifiers to the Insight roll from hymn fragments, relics, teachers, knowledge of the Hyperborean language, and combining multiple sources, with the rule that a single source gives Insight only once; includes an example.
quotes: Having only a fragment of a hymn (such as a sacred name or fragments of a prayer string) imposes a –2 penalty on the Insight roll, while a near-complete fragment grants a +2 bonus to the roll.
Having a basic proficiency in Hyperborean grants +1 to the Insight roll for every point the researcher has in the Ability above 4, to a maximum of +3.

entries.title: Consequences of integrating Hyperborean magic
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
entries.summary: Storyguide advice on what each Hyperborean breakthrough would change in the Order: a 19-year Duration, safer spirit travel, vis-less spells and enchantment (supplementing vis with Warping), unlimited shape, material and size, and enchanting Ritual effects.
quotes: This Breakthrough would allow the enchantment of magical devices by supplementing vis with Warping Points, at a rate of 2 Warping Points for every pawn of vis that would have been needed.

related.text: ArM5 p.161 Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Integration of Hedge Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Introduces how Hermetic magi, especially Bonisagus Seekers, study hedge traditions to extend Hermetic theory.

entries.title: The Breakthrough (integrating hedge magic)
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Any magus may attempt to integrate a hedge tradition by accumulating breakthrough points; there are Minor, Major and Hermetic Breakthroughs of increasing difficulty, whose exact requirements the storyguide should vary.
quotes: Typically requires around 30 breakthrough points
Typically requires around 45 breakthrough points
Typically requires around 60 breakthrough points

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, original research

versions.title: The Breakthrough
versions.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
versions.summary: Any magus may try a Breakthrough by accumulating breakthrough points; Minor, Major and Hermetic Breakthroughs differ in scope and in the points they typically need, and each chapter gives its own requirement.
quotes: he must accumulate a number of breakthrough points determined by the type of Breakthrough he is attempting
(Typically requires around 30 breakthrough points.)
(Typically requires around 60 breakthrough points.)

entries.title: Insight (integrating hedge magic)
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: A magus spends seasons studying texts, relics or teachers of a hedge tradition and rolls to gain an insight, which yields Lab Texts and a specified partially Hermetic effect; teachers can also assist.
quotes: make a stress roll of Intelligence + Magic Theory against an Ease Factor of 18
insight Lab Texts have a level equal to the typical number of breakthrough points needed for the type of Breakthrough in question
A teacher can provide a number of insights equal to his (Hedge Magic) Theory Ability, in each Breakthrough associated with his tradition.

entries.title: The Integration Process
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: A five-step summary: find a source, investigate it for Insight, invent the specified spell or device while experimenting, keep researching to the threshold, then reap the consequences.
quotes: gain a number of breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the spell or device

versions.title: The Integration Process
versions.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
versions.summary: Five-step outline for integration: find a source, study it for Insight, invent the fixed effect it inspires, keep gaining breakthrough points until the threshold is met, then face the consequences.
quotes: she gains a number of breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the spell or device

entries.title: Hermetic Use of Hedge Theory
entries.requires: Hedge tradition lacking a Theory Ability
entries.summary: A Hermetic researcher or hedge wizard may invent a (Hedge Magic) Theory Ability as a Hermetic Breakthrough, converting the points to experience and then acting as his own source of insight.
quotes: This Breakthrough normally requires 60 breakthrough points, but the researcher reduces this amount by his greatest existing (Hedge Magic) Theory or Magic Theory Ability Score.

entries.title: Original Research and Ancient Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Breakthrough points from integrating hedge traditions, original research and ancient traditions are interchangeable for reaching a Breakthrough.
quotes: breakthrough points from integration may be added to breakthrough points from original research to determine whether a Breakthrough has been achieved

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, original research

entries.title: Integration by Hedge Wizard Researchers
entries.requires: Hedge wizard with a (Hedge Magic) Theory Score
entries.summary: Hedge wizards can do their own integration research once they have a Theory Ability, but need more breakthrough points than a Hermetic researcher and face disapproving peers.
quotes: a hedge researcher requires double the number of breakthrough points that an equivalent Hermetic researcher would require

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Elementalist magic
entries.summary: Minor Breakthroughs convert Elementalist background Virtues into Hermetic ones; a Major Breakthrough lets a magus substitute a Hermetic Technique or Form for an adapted Elementalist Art.
quotes: a magus may substitute his score in an appropriate Hermetic Technique or Form for his score in the Elementalist Art

related.text: Hedge Magic: Integration of Hedge Magic

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of folk witch magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Introduces example breakthroughs (Subtle Opening, Energy Magic, Sense of the Mystic, Ritual Items) that can be researched from folk witch practices, left to the troupe to allow or adapt.
quotes: It's up to the troupe to decide if any of them are actually possible in your saga.

related.text: Hedge Magic: Integration of Hedge Magic

entries.title: Breakthrough: Subtle Opening
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: A breakthrough that merges the folk witch Opening of the Gift into the Hermetic Opening of the Arts, so apprentices avoid the Arts penalty when learning Supernatural Abilities; the discoverer may write a Lab Text for it.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 30
the apprentice gains the Minor Hermetic Virtue: Subtle Opening

entries.title: Subtle Opening: Integration Effects
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: How Insights contribute to the Subtle Opening: Vim effects, or varying the technique when Opening an apprentice's Arts with an Extraordinary Results roll, with dangers to the apprentice's Gift.
quotes: the magus earns 5 breakthrough points

entries.title: Breakthrough: Energy Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Folk witches are not bound by the Limit of Energy, so studying them can yield additional Creo Corpus and Perdo Corpus guidelines for Fatigue.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 55

entries.title: Breakthrough: Sense of the Mystic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Studying the folk witch Second Sight, which senses invisible creatures without penetrating their Magic Resistance, yields a new Hermetic Virtue improving Intellego sensing magic; any character with Second Sight can provide insight.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45

entries.title: Breakthrough: Ritual Items
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Integrating potion brewing could let magi make charged items that hold ritual effects, which is particularly powerful together with Energy Magic.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45

entries.title: Integration of Gruagach Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of gruagach magic
entries.summary: Introduces three possible Integration paths by which Hermetic magi can research gruagach magic.

entries.title: Integration: Cailleach Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Cailleach Magic
entries.summary: Integration of the gruagach Cailleach Magic spontaneous casting ability into Hermetic theory: obstacles, suggested Breakthrough points, the resulting Virtue and its consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45
The Virtue Cailleach Magic is identical to Diedne Magic, except that the character does not receive the Dark Secret Flaw, but suffers from the Hedge Wizard Flaw instead.

entries.title: Integration: Flexible Formulaic Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Flexible Formulaic Magic
entries.summary: Integration of gruagach flexible Formulaic casting into Hermetic theory as a new Spell Mastery Ability, with suggested Breakthrough points, optional related Breakthroughs and consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 30

A magus with Spell Mastery in Flexible Formulaic Magic is able to vary one parameter of a Formulaic spell (Range, Duration, Target, or size) as long as the final level of the spell is within one magnitude for every full five points of the magus' Mastery Score.

entries.title: Integration: Improved Voice Range
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Improved Voice Range
entries.summary: Integration of the gruagach ability to affect unsensed targets within hearing, with suggested Breakthrough points, the resulting rule and a suggested extra magnitude.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 60
It is suggested that the magnitude for Improved Voice spells be +3

entries.title: Integrating the Learned Magicians' Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of learned magician magic
entries.summary: Introduces the possible Breakthrough for a magus who integrates learned magician magic with Hermetic magic.

entries.title: Integration: Single-Use Charged Items
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Single-Use Charged Items
entries.summary: Integration of chartae creation into Hermetic theory so a magus can quickly create single-use charged items: suggested Breakthrough points, sources of Insight, the one-device-per-season limit during Integration and the consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 40
The magus may only create one device per season until he achieves a Breakthrough.

entries.title: Hermetic Nightwalkers and Certamen Origins
entries.requires: Major Breakthrough (Nightwalker integrated into Hermetic theory)
entries.summary: An optional saga rule: certamen derives from nightwalking, and a Major Breakthrough could let Hermetic magi gain the Nightwalker Virtue with phantastica shaped by their highest Technique and Form pair, with consequences for House Tremere's Focus (Certamen).
quotes: Hermetic magi do not have a certamen score, just as nightwalkers do not have a Nightwalking score.

entries.title: Path of Seeming Spirit Travel
entries.summary: Optional research: a Minor or Major Breakthrough could replace the Station of Passing Through Seeming with a spirit-travel power resembling Nightwalker with a human phantasticum and no required spirit battles.
quotes: This is a Minor Breakthrough for a researcher who has mastered the Station of Passing Through Seeming, or a Major Breakthrough for one who has not done this.

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Rune Magic
entries.summary: Optional rule: investigating vitkir and runes can become a Major Breakthrough giving a Rune Duration and Inscription Target, and Odin's Sacrifice may give an automatic Discovery. Notes the Order's enmity toward the vitkir.
quotes: the magus receives a new Rune Duration and a new Inscription Target

entries.title: Insight of the Realms (Realm Lore in ceremonial totals, regio detection)
entries.requires: Virtue: Insight of the Realms (Hermetic, researched or integrated)
entries.summary: Lets a maga substitute the matching Realm Lore Ability for Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in ritual and ceremonial casting totals within or related to that realm, and use Realm Lore to detect and see through a regio boundary in place of Second Sight or Sense Holiness & Unholiness.
quotes: may substitute the appropriate Realm Lore Ability for either Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in any ritual or ceremonial spell totals cast within or related to the matching realm

entries.title: True Understanding of the Realms (reducing foreign aura levels)
entries.requires: Virtue: True Understanding of the Realms (Hermetic)
entries.summary: Her Realm Lore scores reduce the effective level of a foreign supernatural aura, lowering the realm interaction penalty, extra botch dice, and aura side effects, and also help the penetration of enchanted devices. Includes how it interacts with the sigil, talismans, and the cost to integrate, with a worked example.
quotes: the effective level of that aura is reduced by the score in the appropriate Realm Lore Ability to a minimum of 0
it takes 30 points to integrate or research this virtue, otherwise it takes 45 points.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.16

entries.title: The Constant Expression (Flaw with extended rules)
entries.requires: Flaw: The Constant Expression (gained when initiating Conciatta's Virtues)
entries.summary: A maga who perpetually casts minor non-fatiguing spontaneous effects can suppress them with a Concentration roll, must make further rolls to cast ceremonial or ritual magic with extra botch dice, and makes any laboratory she works in riskier.
quotes: making an initial Stamina + Concentration simple roll against Ease Factor 3 + (Warping Score)

entries.title: Researching Binding Magic as a Breakthrough
entries.summary: Suggests that integrating faerie or hedge powers that enforce oaths could be a Minor or Major Hermetic Breakthrough, since Hermetic magic cannot directly enforce agreements.
quotes: Researching or integrating a particular faerie power might be a Minor Breakthrough, while allowing freedom to vary the parameters and create similar spells may be a Major Breakthrough.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26

entries.title: Touching the Sky: Breakthrough Points for Aetheric Research
entries.summary: Summarises how breakthrough points are earned (experimenting on effects or studying a source of insight, one point per magnitude) and the point costs for breakthroughs such as Aetheric Magic, new Durations and new versions of the Parma Magica or Aegis of the Hearth.
quotes: each magnitude of effect contributes one breakthrough point toward the specific breakthrough
Each of the new Durations represents a Minor Breakthrough requiring 30 breakthrough points, while a New Parma Magica or Aegis of the Hearth would take 60 points.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26

entries.title: Sample Aetheric Magic Projects
entries.requires: Research towards the Aetheric Magic breakthrough
entries.summary: A set of example research effects, grouped by Technique, that count toward the Aetheric Magic breakthrough, with the number of further breakthrough points each Technique still needs once the examples are completed.
quotes: The examples below provide a total of 84 breakthrough points.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 experimentation

entries.title: What is Insight? (Muspelli sources of Insight)
entries.requires: Original Research rules, or the storyguide's substitute
entries.summary: Explains that Insight comes from objects, texts or bodies that help a researcher towards a breakthrough, offers an experience-based substitute if those rules are not used, and notes that dead Muspelli stop being Arcane Connections to their patrons.
quotes: Once dead, Muspelli are no longer Arcane Connections to their Jotun patrons.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages (Original Research)

entries.title: Gruagach Spellcasting
entries.summary: Gives the gruagach casting score and casting-total formulas for Formulaic and Spontaneous spells, the Fatigue consequences of casting, and how Formulaic spells can be varied in Range, Duration, Target or size.
quotes: Technique + Form + Stamina + Aura Modifier
(Casting Score + Stress Die) / 2
The final spell must be within 2 magnitudes of the original spell

entries.title: Gruagach Spell Mastery
entries.summary: Gruagachan may master Formulaic spells as Hermetic magi do and use Mastery Abilities the troupe allows, except Quiet Casting.

entries.title: Gruagach Flexible Casting Mastery
entries.summary: A Mastery Ability that widens, with Mastery Score, how many magnitudes a gruagach can vary a known Formulaic spell.
quotes: For every full five points in the gruagach's Mastery Score, add one to the number of magnitudes by which he can vary the Range, Duration, Target, or size of a known Formulaic spell.

entries.title: Gruagach Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: Lists the limited Range, Duration and Target parameters gruagach spells may use, their base parameters, the vocalization requirement, and the Conversation Range.
quotes: The base parameters for Shape and Vision spells are Personal, Momentary, and Individual. The base parameters for Blessing and Curse spells are Conversation, Momentary, and Individual.
Range: Personal, Conversation (0/+1), and Voice (+1/+2)

entries.title: Geas and Limit Durations
entries.summary: Introduces the Geas and Limit condition Durations, comparable to the Merinita condition Durations but with difficulty varying by how broad the prohibition is or how easily it can be ended.
quotes: The gruagach Durations never require a Ritual

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.100

entries.title: Geas and Limit Duration Magnitudes
entries.summary: Table of the magnitude added to a spell by Geas or Limit Durations depending on whether the prohibition is sweeping, general or specific.
quotes: Geas (Condition) | +4 magnitudes

entries.title: Geas (Condition) Duration
entries.summary: Rules for geasa: magical prohibitions with grave consequences if broken, which Techniques and Forms may use them, how the caster states the condition, and how the geas and Limit Durations combine.
quotes: Geasa come in the following three varieties: sweeping prohibitions (+4 magnitudes), general prohibitions (+2 magnitudes), and specific prohibitions (+1 magnitude).
only the larger of the two Durations is added to the magnitude of the spell

entries.title: Limit (Condition) Duration
entries.summary: Rules for the Limit Duration used by all Blessing and Curse spells, where ease of lifting the spell sets its cost, and how geasa carry two conditions.
quotes: All Blessing and Curse spells must use the Limit (Condition) Duration.

entries.title: Sweeping Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines sweeping prohibitions, with examples, and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost for geasa versus blessings and curses.
quotes: Sweeping prohibitions for geasa are the equivalent of Year Duration and add +4 magnitudes to the level of the spell.

entries.title: General Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines general prohibitions, comparable to the Flaw Restriction, with examples and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost.
quotes: General prohibitions are the equivalent of Sun Duration and add +2 magnitudes to the level of the spell cast.

entries.title: Specific Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines specific prohibitions, narrower than the Flaw Restriction, with examples and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost for geasa versus blessings and curses.
quotes: Specific prohibitions for geasa are the equivalent of Diameter Duration and add +1 magnitude to the level of the spell cast.

entries.title: Poetic Justice (geas and curse resistance)
entries.summary: A geas or curse that does not suit the victim's past acts is easier to resist; a table of modifiers to the victim's Stamina check measures how appropriate the geas and curse are.
quotes: the victim receives a bonus to his Stamina check to avoid the effects of the geas or curse
The geas and/or curse are perfectly appropriate to address some past event

entries.title: Geas and Limit Durations in Play
entries.summary: How conditions are articulated in play, how gruagach flexibility lets a spell be altered when cast, and Warping: a Geas does not count as active until broken, but a Limit is active.
quotes: A spell with Geas Duration does not count as an active supernatural effect until the character breaks the prohibition
a typical gruagach may alter freely the Range, Target, or Duration of a spell by 10 levels

entries.title: Gruagach Alternative (all spells use Limit or Geas)
entries.summary: Optional rule making every gruagach spell and laboratory effect use the Limit or Geas Durations.
quotes: the troupe may decide that all spells and Laboratory effects by gruagachan must use the Limit or Geas Durations

entries.title: Blessing Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Blessing spells that temporarily grant Virtues, Ability bonuses and Characteristic improvements, and Take Blessing spells that remove Virtues, with the requirement that prohibitions fit the story.

entries.title: Give Blessing Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Blessing spells, which grant Virtues, Ability bonuses or Characteristic increases, with limits on which Virtues may be given and descriptions of sweeping, general and specific prohibitions.
quotes: Level 5: Provide a bonus of +1 to a single Ability roll.
Level 20: Grant a Major General or Supernatural (Magic) Virtue.

entries.title: Take Blessing Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Blessing spells, which nullify Virtues, Abilities or Characteristics, including how the storyguide picks the target and the victim's Stamina resistance roll with poetic justice modifiers.
quotes: Level 10: Reduce the score in a single Ability to 0.
the target has the opportunity to resist it with a Stamina check against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Curse Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Curse spells, which inflict Flaws or reduce Characteristics and Abilities, and Take Curse spells, which remove curses and lingering magic.

entries.title: Give Curse Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Curse spells that inflict Flaws, diseases, injuries or penalties, which Flaws cannot be inflicted, prohibition types, the victim's Stamina resistance roll and the required Geas or Limit Duration.
quotes: All Give Curse spells must have either the Geas or Limit Duration.
Level 15: Inflict a serious disease.

entries.title: Take Curse Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Take Curse spells that learn the terms of or remove curses, the risk to a caster who fails or botches, and how Hermetic magic can dispel gruagach curses.
quotes: If a gruagach fails to remove a curse, the caster suffers the effects of the curse also.

entries.title: Shape Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Give Shape and Take Shape spells for altering the physical shape of another or oneself, noting that carried items are incorporated into the new form.

entries.title: Give Shape Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Shape spells that add features of other creatures or transform a willing recipient, including the target's inability to back out once the change is accepted.
quotes: Give Shape spells are only effective on a willing recipient.

entries.title: Take Shape Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Shape spells that force a foreign form on a target or let the caster mimic one, including the Stamina resistance roll modified by Personality Traits.
quotes: the player would need to succeed at an Ease Factor of 6 to resist

entries.title: Vision Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Vision spells that control perception, create simple illusions, grant invisibility, send out the fetch, and give glimpses of the future.

entries.title: Give Vision Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Vision spells that create sight and sound illusions or grant Visions and Premonitions on a chosen topic, with magnitude increases for complex or moving images.
quotes: Level 1: Create an image that affects sight or sound.

entries.title: Take Vision Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Vision spells that use senses at a distance via the fetch, detect vis, discern or dispel illusions, and destroy an object's effect on hearing or sight.
quotes: Level 1: Detect the presence of vis.

entries.title: Gruagach Botches
entries.summary: Describes botch results for each gruagach Form, which follow the Hermetic botch guidelines, and notes that Vision botches inflict extra Warping Points.
quotes: every Vision botch inflicts double the normal Warping Points

entries.title: Gruagach Transformation (the Curse of Gruagach)
entries.summary: The gruagach equivalent of Twilight and Warping: when a gruagach gains Warping Points from a botch or other powerful effect he rolls to avoid transformation, slowly becoming troll-like.
quotes: Stamina + Concentration + Vision Magic Defense Bonus + stress die vs. Warping Score + Number of Warping Points Gained + local aura + stress die

entries.title: Effects of Transformation
entries.summary: After a transformation the Understanding Transformation roll decides whether the experience is good or bad, and at a high enough Warping Score the gruagach becomes a troll controlled by the storyguide.
quotes: Intelligence + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die
When a character reaches a Warping Score of 10, the transformation to a troll is complete.

entries.title: Gruagach Good Transformation Experiences
entries.summary: Options for a good transformation: a gruagach magic Virtue, a troll Virtue, or bonus experience in an Art.
quotes: The gruagach acquires Experience Points in a pre-existing Art equivalent to the character's Warping Score + simple die.

entries.title: Gruagach Bad Transformation Experiences
entries.summary: Options for a bad transformation: a gruagach magic Flaw, a troll Flaw such as Repellent, or lost experience in an Art.
quotes: The gruagach loses Experience Points in a pre-existing Art equivalent to the character's Warping Score + simple die.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.89 Repellent

entries.title: Gruagachan in Play (covenant involvement)
entries.summary: Explains how gruagachan appear as allies or adversaries to a covenant, how non-Order gruagachan are generated, and that they can supply covenant Boons and Hooks.

entries.title: Construction: Earth Jacketed In Stone
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Introduces the method of building an artificial island by casting Creo Terram rituals that make a thick stone wall jacketing an infill of earth.

entries.title: Outer Wall Shapes
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Describes the default design of the island's sea wall, how changing its height changes its diameter, and how a few extra spell levels greatly increase its area.
quotes: an extra 5 spell levels increases the area incredibly

entries.title: Open Ended Cylinder
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives the spell levels needed to create an open-ended cylindrical wall of a given diameter, and recommends treating a conical frustum as a cylinder for calculation.
quotes: A level 30 spell creates a wall 30 paces high, 2 paces thick, and just over 3 miles in diameter.

entries.title: Tall Empty Cylinder
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives the spell levels for a much taller cylindrical wall suited to deeper water, with correspondingly smaller diameters.
quotes: A level 30 spell creates a wall 240 paces high, two paces thick, and just over a third of a mile in diameter.

entries.title: Simple Spells to Create Permanent Walls
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: A set of ritual spells that create permanent stone walls of increasing volume, showing how size magnitudes scale and noting that rituals below a certain volume gain no advantage.
quotes: which is a total of 100 cubic paces of stone
Due to the quirk of Hermetic magic that makes all Rituals fourth magnitude spells or greater

entries.title: Open Ended Rectangular Prism
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives the spell levels for walls forming a rectangular island, noting that it suffers more erosion than a cylinder and that a pyramidal frustum is a better shape.
quotes: A level 30 spell creates sufficient stone to make walls 30 paces high, 2 paces wide, and a top square with 4,166 paces (2.4 miles) per side.

entries.title: Solid Stone Cylinder
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives the spell levels for a single monolithic stone cylinder that can be quarried into to create rooms.
quotes: A level 30 spell creates a stone cylinder 30 paces high and 206 paces in diameter.

entries.title: Ablative Slope
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Explains how a slope of mud or sand at the base of the wall protects it from wave erosion and how its spell level compares with the wall's.
quotes: the spell to create an ablative slope is three magnitudes lower than the spell that creates the wall

entries.title: Ornamentation
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Wall features can be added by raising the spell level of the initial spell, or retrofitted afterwards with Rego Terram or mundane craftsmen.

entries.title: Maximum Magnitudes Due to Complexity
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Suggests the troupe cap the magnitudes added by complex features, after which the magus can shape his creation freely.
quotes: after adding three magnitudes for complexity, the magus can manipulate his creation into any shape he wishes, without adding extra magnitudes

entries.title: Fortified Wall
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Lists fortress features for the sea wall and whether each adds a magnitude to the spell or merely uses stone: crenellations, fire step, height, machicolations and hoardings.
quotes: Adding crenellations adds a magnitude.

entries.title: Sea Gates and Docks
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: A sea gate and internal harbor wall add a single magnitude to the wall spell, with extra material needed for the harbor.
quotes: it adds 1 magnitude because it has some metal parts, but requires no added material

entries.title: Statuary
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Statues or reliefs on the wall cost nothing if they express the caster's sigil, otherwise they add a magnitude.
quotes: If they are an artistic motif, they add a magnitude.

entries.title: Base Metal Walls
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Walls of copper, bronze, brass or iron alloys cost extra magnitudes to create compared with stone, and the section gives example wall sizes by spell level.
quotes: The base spell level is two magnitudes higher, while the base Individual of is 1/27th the volume.

entries.title: Noble Metal Walls
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Walls of silver or gold are possible with very high-level spells but are much more difficult than base metals and attract invaders.
quotes: Walls made of valuable metals are three magnitudes more difficult to create than walls of base metals of equivalent size.

entries.title: Unnatural Stones
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Adding a Muto requisite lets the wall have unnatural properties, with further requisites needed for effects such as burning or self-healing.
quotes: By adding a Muto requisite to the ritual used to create the wall, magi can create stone with unnatural properties.

entries.title: Biological Substances
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Walls of wood or bone are equally difficult to produce by volume, but vulnerable to predators and faerie influence, and human bone is as hard as base metal.
quotes: When calculating volumes, stone, animal bone, and wood are equally difficult to produce.

entries.title: Dirt, With a Layer of Topsoil
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives the soil volumes needed to fill islands of various sizes and the Creo Terram ritual levels that provide that volume.
quotes: A level 35 spell provides up to 10 billion cubic paces of soil.

entries.title: A Basic Quote (Island Cost)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Worked example of the spells, vis and time needed to create a circular island of a given size with a standard wall and soil fill.
quotes: that requires just two spells, a level 35 and a level 40, and 15 pawns of vis

entries.title: Clay Fill
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Clay fill is as easy to create as soil and is waterproof, so the soil calculations can be used for a topsoil-over-clay fill.
quotes: Clay is as easy to create as soil.

entries.title: Stone Fill
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Stone fill is harder to create than soil, and choosing a variety of stones adds a magnitude for complexity.
quotes: Stone is three magnitudes more difficult to create than soil of the same volume.

entries.title: Rooms and Utility Spaces
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Excavated or created underground rooms need extra magnitudes for elaborate design, using Conjuring the Mystic Tower as a reference.
quotes: adds 3 magnitudes for elaborate design

entries.title: Road Works
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Explains why paved roads are the only worthwhile road to create magically and gives a ritual that makes road networks of a stated maximum length, with extra magnitudes for complex designs.
quotes: the maximum length for this spell, which is 3.78 miles

entries.title: Creating Houses and Other Buildings
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Ways of making housing on the island, including shell keeps and rituals that raise many identical cottages, with each added magnitude multiplying the number produced by ten.
quotes: Every magnitude added to the spell multiplies the number of cottages produced by ten.

entries.title: Water Works
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Covers cisterns, canals and aqueducts on the island, with rituals that create stone-lined canals for local use and for seagoing vessels, scaled by spell level.
quotes: A single horse can draw 30 tons of cargo on a barge

entries.title: Creating Fields and Forests
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Herbam rituals that create forests, acorns or grassland, where each added magnitude multiplies the quantity created by ten.
quotes: Each added magnitude multiples this number of trees by 10.

entries.title: How Many Peasants Are Needed?
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Gives manor size, income and peasant families per manor to estimate how many manors an island of a given size can support.
quotes: A typical manor, for a landed knight, is 600 acres.
This provides 20 Mythic Pounds of income, before expenses, each year.

entries.title: Charms Overview
entries.summary: Charms are cast and learned like Formulaic spells; there are no spontaneous charms, but a magician can cast unlearned charms from a text.

entries.title: Charm Design and Casting Totals
entries.summary: Gives the learned magician casting score and the charm totals for known and text-read charms, with success, Fatigue and failure thresholds and which die applies.
quotes: Hedge Technique + Hedge Form + Communication + Aura Modifier
(Casting Score + Die) / 2
(Casting Score + Stress Die) / 5

entries.title: Ranges, Durations, & Targets for Charms
entries.summary: Table of the Range, Duration and Target parameters available to charms, with their magnitude modifiers.
quotes: Range: Personal, Eye/Touch (+1), and Voice (+2)

entries.title: Reading Charms from Text
entries.summary: How a learned magician finds and casts charms from a formulary: the search roll, reading time per magnitude, Language penalties, and how the storyguide decides what a formulary contains.
quotes: The player must make an Intelligence + Language roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Charm Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: Charms use the Hermetic parameters from a restricted list, are fixed once known and cannot be altered during casting, and a related charm still gives the Lab Total bonus.
quotes: The base parameters for a charm are Personal, Momentary, and Individual.

entries.title: Learned Magician Vis Use
entries.summary: Learned magicians use raw vis in charm casting under the Hermetic rules and a table of which kinds of vis suit each Art, but they cannot study from vis.
quotes: Learned magicians may not study from vis.

entries.title: Fortunam Charms and Magic Resistance
entries.summary: Explains what Fortunam charms do for each Technique and the special rules for when a Fortunam charm must penetrate Magic Resistance.
quotes: it does not need to penetrate anyone's Magic Resistance other than his own

entries.title: Tueor Fortunam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Tueor Fortunam charms that remove botch dice, allow re-rolls of failed Ability rolls up to set Ease Factors and prevent mishaps, with the rule that the charm must penetrate an opposing character's Magic Resistance.
quotes: Level 1: Allow a player to re-roll a failed roll for a single Ability where the Ease Factor is no more than 3 and use the better of the two rolls.

entries.title: Succurro Fortunam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Succurro Fortunam charms that grant luck bonuses, Ability bonuses or Virtues, and which must penetrate the Magic Resistance of the target and anyone the character acts against.
quotes: Level 1: Provide a bonus of +1 to all Luck related rolls.

entries.title: Vulnero Fortunam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Vulnero Fortunam curses that add botch dice, penalize Ability rolls or force rerolls, including the Perception plus Magic Lore roll for a victim to notice the curse.
quotes: To discover the curse, the player must roll a Perception + Magic Lore against an Ease Factor of 12, minus the magnitude of the Vulnero Fortunam charm

entries.title: Magicam Charms Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Magicam charms for each Technique, notes that they cannot control demons directly, and explains that general guidelines must be learned at a specific level.
