entries.title: Tueor Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Tueor Magicam charms that protect against a specific type of hostile magical damage or Supernatural Ability, adding to Soak, Defense or Ease Factors.
quotes: General: Add +2 to the Target's Soak Total for damage caused by magical damage of specific type for every level of the base charm effect.

entries.title: Succurro Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Succurro Magicam charms that grant Supernatural Ability bonuses or Magic Realm Virtues, or boost existing charms and amulets.
quotes: Level 2: Provide a bonus of +1 to rolls for a single Supernatural Ability.

entries.title: Vulnero Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Vulnero Magicam charms that shorten continuing magic or ward against creatures of a realm below a given Might, with the Target referring to a single spell.
quotes: If the victim of the spell has Magical Resistance, the charm must penetrate to be effective.

entries.title: Salutem Charms Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Salutem charms, which cover the health of humans, animals, crops and structures but cannot improve Characteristics, change shape or control movement.

entries.title: Tueor Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Tueor Salutem protective charms against broad or narrow categories of damage, disease, poison and wards against animals or people, with limits on wards and magical damage.
quotes: Tueor Salutem wards can only be placed on locations with either a Structure or Boundary Target.

related.text: ArM5 Greater Immunity and Lesser Immunity

entries.title: Succurro Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Succurro Salutem charms, which follow Creo Corpus but cannot heal permanently, covering Recovery bonuses, plant growth, Living Conditions and aging crises, best used as amulets and chartae.
quotes: Level 2: Give a character a +6 bonus to Recovery rolls for a single non-magical disease, poison, or injury.

entries.title: Vulnero Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Vulnero Salutem charms, which follow Perdo Corpus, inflicting wounds, lost Fatigue, crippled limbs, destroyed senses and diseases.
quotes: Level 5: Inflict a Light Wound.

entries.title: Learned Magician Botches
entries.summary: Describes botch results for Fortunam, Salutem and Magicam charms, following the Hermetic botch guidelines.

entries.title: Learned Magician Warping
entries.summary: Magicians gain Warping Points from the usual sources and from zeros on botch dice when casting charms, and may suffer an intervention if a single botch gives two or more points.
quotes: Like Hermetic magi, magicians also gain 1 Warping Point for every 0 that comes up on the botch dice when casting a charm.

entries.title: Intervention (learned magician Twilight analogue)
entries.summary: When Warping from a botch triggers an intervention, a realm entity confronts the magician; an avoidance roll and an appeasement roll decide whether he receives a boon or a punishment such as a Flaw tied to that realm.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration + (Magicam Score / 5) + stress die vs. Warping Score + Number of Warping Points Gained + (Realm) aura + stress die
Communication + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die

entries.title: Abduction
entries.summary: Once the Warping Score is high enough, the offended realm entity abducts the magician for a number of seasons, and at a higher score the effect becomes permanent.
quotes: Once the learned magician's Warping Score reaches 7, the entity takes more-direct action.
When the character's Warping Score becomes 10, the effect becomes permanent.

entries.title: Epistolary Community (Gifted mathematici and correspondence)
entries.summary: Gifted mathematici use long correspondence to overcome the social effects of The Gift, and a successful Communication plus Charm roll can let a face-to-face meeting count as an established relationship instead of a first impression.
quotes: successful in a Communication + Charm roll against an Ease Factor set by the storyguide

related.text: ArM5 p.76 First Impression and Established Relationship

entries.title: Learned Magicians in Play (covenant involvement)
entries.summary: Explains how mathematici appear as allies or adversaries of a covenant, how non-Order mathematici are generated, and that they provide covenant Boons and Hooks.

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities (type)
entries.requires: Virtue granting the Ability, or The Gift
entries.summary: Rules for obtaining Supernatural Abilities at creation, their realm of origin and the Warping immunity that goes with it, and how The Gift lets Gifted characters learn them in play.
quotes: Characters may only gain Supernatural Abilities during character creation if they have the Virtue granting the Ability.
If you have no reason to choose otherwise, your Ability is granted by the Magic realm

entries.title: Animal Ken
entries.summary: Lets the character communicate with animals, using their score as if it were skill in a language the animal speaks fluently.
quotes: Treat your score in Animal Ken as your score in a language that the animal speaks fluently in order to determine how well you can communicate

entries.title: Corpse Magic
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to temporarily animate or question a suitable corpse, using a Casting Total and a Commanding roll compared against Ease Factors.
quotes: Communication + Corpse Magic + Aura modifier + stress die
Communication + Leadership + stress die

entries.title: Corpse Magic Ease Factor Outcome
entries.summary: Table of what Corpse Magic achieves at each Ease Factor, including speaking to, animating and commanding corpses and the Ease Factors for commands.
quotes: Single word commands have an Ease Factor of 6, simple questions or commands require a 9, and more complex instructions or questions need a 12 or more.

entries.title: Crafter's Healing
entries.summary: Supernatural healing of wounds one level at a time at the cost of a Long-Term Fatigue level, using a roll against the Wound Recovery improvement Ease Factor, with Warping for the recipient.
quotes: Make a Presence + Crafter's Healing + stress die roll against an Ease Factor equal to the Improvement Ease Factor determined by the Wound Recovery Table

entries.title: Curse-Throwing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability that moves diseases, curses and harmful effects from a sufferer to another recipient through a ritual, with a Casting Total against Ease Factors for the curse and modifiers for the recipient's link.
quotes: Presence + Curse-Throwing + Aura + stress die
PENETRATION TOTAL: Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus

entries.title: Dowsing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to locate nearby things with a dowsing rod, with search time depending on area and Ease Factor depending on rarity and distance.
quotes: To find something common, like water, within 25 paces requires a Perception + Dowsing of 9+.

entries.title: Enchanting (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural performance Ability that sways emotions; roll Communication plus the Ability against Ease Factors for different effects, with Magic Resistance and botch rules.
quotes: An Ease Factor of 9 will calm the upset, 12 will win someone's love, 15 will incite a riot, and a 24 might win back a soul from the Prince of Darkness.

entries.title: Entrancement
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to command a person by eye contact, resolved against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus to the victim depending on how objectionable the command is.
quotes: Roll Presence + Entrancement against the target's Stamina roll.

entries.title: Font of Knowledge
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability letting a creature try a task using an untrained Ability, with an Ease Factor that rises with the number of uses in a day.
quotes: Intelligence + Font of Knowledge + stress die

entries.title: Induction
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to create illusions only the target perceives; Ease Factors rise with the risk the victim takes by believing the illusion, with roll modifiers, repeat attempts and rules for whether the victim realizes magic was used.
quotes: Attempts at induction require a die roll of Communication + Induction.
A victim of induction realizes afterwards that they have been affected by magic if the roll above does not exceed the Ease Factor by (6-1 per factor from the list below).

entries.title: Entrancement and Induction
entries.summary: Explains how Entrancement and Induction differ and how a character with both can use each to support the other.
quotes: Entrancement takes control of a character's will, and dictates their actions, but does not affect what they believe or experience.

entries.title: Magic Sensitivity
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense the magical nature of places, items, spells and creatures, which lowers Magic Resistance and uses a roll against storyguide-set Ease Factors with guidelines for each target.
quotes: simply roll a simple die + Perception + Magic Sensitivity
Detecting a Magic aura would normally have an Ease Factor equal to 12 – aura level

entries.title: Persona
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to assume different identities, changing appearance fully while keeping Characteristics, with one identity per point and a roll to change.
quotes: a roll of Stamina + Persona against an Ease Factor of 9
The character gains one identity for every point he has in the Persona Ability.

entries.title: Premonitions
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense approaching danger, rolled against an Ease Factor that depends on how imminent and serious the danger is.
quotes: Roll Perception + Premonitions against an Ease Factor depending on the situation.

entries.title: Second Sight
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to see through illusory concealment and naturally invisible things, with Ease Factors based on the magnitude of the concealing effect or fixed for invisible things.
quotes: All Second Sight rolls are Perception + Second Sight, and they are almost always simple rolls.
The Ease Factor to see through illusionary concealment is normally equal to 6 + the magnitude of the might of the creature responsible for the effect, or 6 + the magnitude of a Hermetic spell.

entries.title: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
entries.summary: Divine Supernatural Ability to feel good and evil, with different Ease Factors for an area, a person or object, a demon and a hidden angel.
quotes: A Perception + Sense Holiness and Unholiness roll against an Ease Factor of 9 lets you sense holiness or unholiness in a general area; against an Ease Factor of 15, in a person or object.

entries.title: Sense Passions
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense emotions and Personality Traits in beings and the tarnish or temper of auras, with a limited ability to recognize spirits and holy or unholy presences.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + Sense Passions + Aura

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, page 13
Realms of Power: The Divine Revised Edition, page 38

entries.title: Shapeshifter
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to take the shape of a mundane animal within a size range, with a Stamina roll to change and one shape known per point.
quotes: a roll of Stamina + Shapeshifter against an Ease Factor of 9
You have a limited repertoire of shapes, one for every point you have in the Shapeshift ability.

entries.title: Wilderness Sense
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to determine direction, weather, hazards or resources in the wild with one piece of information per roll.
quotes: A Perception + Wilderness Sense roll against an Ease Factor of 9 lets you determine the direction of north, the upcoming weather, or the presence of natural hazards or resources.

entries.title: Divination & Augury — Major Supernatural Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces Hermetic Divination as interpretive, not predictive, and subject to the Limit of Time.
quotes: The divination is inherently interpretive in nature and not predictive, and is subject to the Limit of Time

entries.title: Hermetic Divination
entries.summary: Hermetic Divination gives results equivalent to Intellego spells of any Form, and is more flexible than Formulaic Magic but weaker, covering all ten Forms with a single Ability.
quotes: Hermetic Divination provides results equivalent to casting Hermetic Intellego spells of any Form.

entries.title: Method and Additional Methods
entries.summary: Choosing a method of divination, how the first Initiation grants Divination at level 1, and how extra methods are added as Minor Virtues with prerequisites for Astrology, Numerology and Dream Interpretation.
quotes: the Initiation rites enable him to learn the Supernatural Ability Divination at level 1

entries.title: Limitation
entries.summary: Divination only answers questions, is limited to Momentary effects, and cannot simulate Ritual Magic.
quotes: Hermetic Divination cannot simulate the effects of Ritual Magic.

entries.title: Ease Factor
entries.summary: Any non-Ritual Intellego question of Momentary Duration can be attempted; the Ease Factor is the equivalent spell level and the diviner rolls Characteristic + Divination + Aura + Bonuses against it.
quotes: Stress Die + Characteristic + Divination + Aura + Bonuses vs. Ease Factor
The Ease Factor for Hermetic Divination is the level of the equivalent Hermetic spell.
In Divination, an Arcane Connection held in the hand may be interpreted as if the diviner were Touching the target

entries.title: Example Divinations
entries.summary: Worked examples of working out the Ease Factor for common divination questions from equivalent Intellego guidelines.
quotes: The Ease Factor is 15 (Base 10, +1 Eye, or +1 touching an AC).

entries.title: Penetration
entries.summary: A divination's Penetration is the Divination Total plus Penetration Bonus less the Ease Factor.
quotes: Divination Total + Penetration Bonus – Ease Factor

entries.title: Ceremonial Augury Phenomena
entries.summary: Table of divination methods, what each observes, and the Ceremonial Bonus it gives for different types of question.

entries.title: Casual Divination
entries.summary: Divination taking one round by reading signs in the immediate environment, rolled with Perception against the equivalent spell level, with no open-ended roll.
quotes: Casual Divination takes one round
Stress Die + Perception + Divination + Aura + Bonus vs. Ease Factor (Equivalent Spell Level)

entries.title: Ceremonial Divination
entries.summary: A slower divination, taking time per magnitude of Ease Factor, that allows sympathetic magic and devices and uses Intelligence in the roll.
quotes: Ceremonial Divination takes 15 minutes per 5 Ease Factors (the same as 15 minutes per magnitude)
Stress Die + Intelligence + Divination + Aura + Bonuses vs. Ease Factor (Equivalent Spell Level)

entries.title: Divination Bonuses
entries.summary: The three bonuses added to a Ceremonial Divination roll: Ceremonial Bonus (+1 to +5 from the method), Sympathetic Magic Bonus from Arcane Connections and similar links, and Magical Bonus from an enchanted divinatory device.
quotes: This ranges from +1 to +5.
The magus adds Ceremonial Bonus, sympathetic bonus, and Magic Bonus to the roll against the Ease Factor for the divination.

entries.title: Hermetic Dream Interpreter — Major Supernatural Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Dream interpretation as a specialised divination method, which can also be Initiated as an extra Minor Virtue by a diviner.
quotes: Hermetic Dream Interpretation permits Casual and Ceremonial Divination in a specialized manner through the interpretation of dreams.

entries.title: Hermetic Dream Interpretation
entries.summary: States that Hermetic Dream Interpretation uses the Divination and Augury rules plus the special uses described afterwards.
quotes: Hermetic Dream Interpretation uses the rules for Hermetic Divination and Augury in this chapter.

entries.title: Divinatory Interpretation
entries.summary: Using dream interpretation as Ceremonial Divination by ritual preparation before sleep, or by discussing another person's dream for at least an hour.
quotes: This takes approximately half an hour of preparation

entries.title: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
entries.summary: A general Effect enchanted into a divinatory device whose level sets the Magical Bonus to Ceremonial Divination.
quotes: Magical Bonus = Effect level / 10 (round up)

entries.title: Symbolic Interpretation
entries.summary: A non-divinatory dream reading made with an interpretation total compared to the Ease Factor table to judge how clearly the dream is understood.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Divination (Dream Interpretation)

entries.title: Dream Calling
entries.summary: A supernatural action to ensure a touched person dreams about a chosen subject, rolled against Ease Factor 6.
quotes: Stress Die + Presence + Dream Interpretation + Aura vs. an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: The Egyptian Obelisk: divination roll and Ease Factor
entries.summary: A character may read the obelisk's engravings to divine the future with a roll against a fixed Ease Factor, handled as Hermetic Divination, and the Ease Factor falls if missing pieces are recovered.
quotes: A character may divine the future with an Intelligence + Magic Lore + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of 15.
Finding the other two missing thirds of the obelisk reduces the Ease Factor by 3 for each found piece, so a complete obelisk lowers it to 9.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, pages 59-62 (Hermetic Divination)

entries.title: Spell Mastery Abilities (type)
entries.summary: Spell Mastery Abilities belong to magi and concern casting Formulaic and Ritual spells; full rules are in the Hermetic Magic chapter.
quotes: Spell Mastery Abilities can only be taken by magi

entries.title: Acute Sense (Mastery Ability)
entries.requires: Quaesitorial training (mastery ability for enhanced sense spells)
entries.summary: A new mastery ability for enhanced sense spells that lets a trained Quaesitor notice altered, hidden or destroyed magical traces; the storyguide rolls for the player, and taking it twice adds the Mastery score to the roll.
quotes: Perception + Penetration + Stress die
6 + the magnitude of the Might of the creature responsible for the effect or 6 + the magnitude of a Hermetic spell

entries.title: Boosted Casting
entries.summary: A mastered spell ability allowing the caster to spend vis to increase a spell's Range, Duration, Target or size by one magnitude per pawn, adding a botch die for each pawn used.
quotes: you do add one additional botch die for each pawn of vis used

entries.title: Harnessed Casting
entries.summary: A mastered spell ability allowing the caster to end the spell's effects at will by concentrating, with a retry allowed if distracted.
quotes: You may end the effects of this spell at will, simply by concentrating on it.

entries.title: Tethered Casting
entries.summary: A mastered spell ability allowing control of the spell to be passed to another person or to an object that casts it when a suitable target comes into range; cannot be used for Ritual spells.
quotes: This cannot be taken for Ritual spells.

entries.title: Mercurian Spell Mastery Abilities
entries.summary: Exclusive Spell Mastery special abilities available to members of the Cult of Mercury.
quotes: The first time in a session that the caster botches a roll for this spell or fails the casting roll by exactly one point, she gains 5 experience points toward Mastery of this spell.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.99-100

entries.title: New Mastery Ability — Ceremonial Casting
entries.requires: Mastery Ability: Ceremonial Casting (Cult of Mercury)
entries.summary: A spell mastery option letting a magus apply the Ceremonial Casting rules to a specific spell that is not already a Ritual using them.
quotes: The maga may apply the rules for Ceremonial Casting (ArM5, page 83) to casting this spell.

entries.title: Cult of Mercury and Neo-Mercurian Spell Mastery Special Abilities (sidebar)
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Sidebar introducing the Mercurian Mastery special abilities: how they are learned from a teacher who knows them, chosen instead of the ArM5 abilities when gaining a Mastery level, and available to characters with Mastered Spells at creation.

entries.title: Ceremonial Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability allowing ceremonial methods for a non-Ritual spell, increasing casting time and adding Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to the total.
quotes: increasing the casting time and adding her Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to her total

versions.title: Ceremonial Casting
versions.summary: A mastered spell ability allowing ceremonial casting of a non-ritual spell, taking longer in exchange for adding the caster's Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to the total.
quotes: increasing the casting time and adding your Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to your total

entries.title: Disguised Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability allowing a magus to suppress or alter his sigil to hide his identity or mimic another magus's, adding Spell Mastery to the roll that determines how hard it is to recognize.
quotes: he may add his Spell Mastery score to the roll that determines how difficult it is to recognize

versions.title: Disguised Casting
versions.summary: A mastered spell ability letting the caster suppress or alter their sigil, or mimic another magus's sigil, with the Spell Mastery score helping against recognition.
quotes: you may add your Spell Mastery score to the roll that determines how difficult it is to recognize

entries.title: Lab Mastery
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability adding the spell mastery score to the Lab Total when designing effects similar to the mastered spell, on top of the standard similar spell bonus.
quotes: she may add her spell mastery score to her Lab Total when designing effects that are similar to it

versions.title: Lab Mastery
versions.summary: A mastered spell ability that adds the spell mastery score to the Lab Total when designing similar effects, in addition to the normal similar-spell bonus.
quotes: you may add your spell mastery score to your Lab Total when designing effects that are similar to it

entries.title: Learn From Mistakes
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability giving experience toward mastery the first time in a session that the magus botches or narrowly fails a roll for the spell.
quotes: he gains 5 experience points toward mastery of this spell

versions.title: Learn from Mistakes
versions.summary: A mastered spell ability that grants mastery experience the first time per session the caster botches or narrowly fails a roll for the spell.
quotes: you gain five experience points towards mastery of this spell

entries.title: Stalwart Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability making a spell less tiring: a Ritual costs normal rather than long-term Fatigue and fewer levels, and a Formulaic spell never costs Fatigue for a low casting total.
quotes: she loses normal Fatigue instead of long-term Fatigue when casting it, and half as many Fatigue levels, rounded up (but always at least 1)

versions.title: Stalwart Casting
versions.summary: A mastered spell ability reducing the Fatigue cost of casting: rituals cost normal rather than long-term Fatigue at half the levels, and formulaic spells never cost Fatigue from a low casting total.
quotes: you never lose Fatigue levels because of a low casting total

entries.title: Apotropaic Mastery
entries.requires: Spell with Infernal Might as its direct target; Hierarchy Score
entries.summary: A spell mastery ability that boosts the effect level of spells aimed directly at Infernal Might, using the caster's Hierarchy Score.
quotes: It allows the caster to add his (Mastery Score x Hierarchy Score) to the level of effect produced by the mastered spell.

entries.title: Goetic Mastery
entries.requires: Goetic Arts; Rego Vim spell targeting spirits
entries.summary: A spell mastery ability for spells that target spirits, adding a Goetic Art to the Casting Total and Hierarchy Score to Penetration, and tainting the spell as Unholy.
quotes: He also adds his (Hierarchy Score x 5) to his Penetration Total when he casts this spell on a demon.

entries.title: Certamen School: Andabatus (Blind Fighting)
entries.summary: A reckless style that trades defense for attack: followers add a Finesse-based bonus to their Attack Total and take an equal penalty to Defense, while imitators get a smaller bonus with a larger penalty.
quotes: The andabatus adds a bonus to his Attack Total of up to twice his Finesse score, but also accepts an equal penalty to his Defense Total.

entries.title: Certamen School: Bestiarius (Beasts)
entries.summary: A technique used only by Bjornaer magi, letting them use Heartbeast instead of Finesse in Muto duels or those involving their own bodies and adding to Resistance in Muto Corpus or Animal duels.
quotes: allows them to use their Heartbeast score instead of their Finesse score during duels in the Muto form

entries.title: Certamen School: Bone-Biting
entries.summary: A self-injuring technique where the duelist takes a Light Wound to ignore upcoming Fatigue losses or boost the next Attack Total, with the shared illusion revealing how much damage was self-inflicted.
quotes: Those fighting in this style cause themselves a Light Wound, and either ignore the loss of the next two fatigue levels, or add ten points to their next Attack Total.

entries.title: Certamen Trick: Charon
entries.summary: A trick allowing a duelist to cast a spell silently during certamen and maintain it so that it lands on the opponent along with the final spell, using Concentration rolls each round, and probably a breach of the Peripheral Code.
quotes: (Intelligence + Concentration of 15+)
(Intelligence + Concentration of 12+ each round)

entries.title: Certamen School: Essedarius (Charioteer)
entries.summary: A psychological style where, after a successful attack, the duelist declines to do damage and instead tries to frighten the foe into surrendering with a Brave check scaled to the Fatigue declined.
quotes: Brave check of 3 + 2 per Fatigue level the essedarius has declined to take during this certamen

entries.title: Certamen School: Gladiatrix (Swordswoman)
entries.summary: A chessboard-based style where a successful attack may target a concept or value of the opponent instead of doing damage, revealing emotional reactions unless the opponent passes an Intelligence roll; also covers chessboard certamen and a team variant with dancers.
quotes: If the opponent does not make an Intelligence roll of 9+

entries.title: Certamen School: Hoplomachus
entries.summary: A defensive style that trades Attack for Defense each round, cannot win initiative against non-hoplomachi, and gains a large Defense bonus when it declines to attack.
quotes: Each round the hoplomachus reduces their Attack Total by up to their Finesse score, then increases their Defense Total by up to twice that penalty.

entries.title: Certamen School: Laquerius (Noose)
entries.summary: A style that takes a Defense penalty and, on landing a blow, may inflict no damage and instead reduce the opponent's Defense for the rest of the duel (one round only for imitators).
quotes: In any round the laquerius can take a Defense Total penalty equal to or less than their Finesse score.

entries.title: Certamen School: Provocator (Challengers)
entries.summary: A style that sacrifices Initiative for protection, converting an Initiative penalty into a lasting Resistance Total bonus, with an alternate approach alternating initiative and Resistance.
quotes: A provocator may accept a penalty on their Initiative Total that is equal or less than their Finesse score, but in all future rounds their Resistance Total attracts a bonus equal to the penalty.

entries.title: Certamen School: Pumilius (Amusing Dwarfs)
entries.summary: A style considered offensive by some, where a successful attack projects a humorous image instead of damage, forcing the opponent to pass an Intelligence + Concentration roll or lose their attack or defense next round.
quotes: If their opponent fails an Intelligence + Concentration roll (target 12+ modified by personality traits)

entries.title: Certamen School: Retiarius (Fisherman)
entries.summary: A swift, evasive style that adds a Finesse-based bonus to the Initiative roll at the cost of Attack Advantage in later rounds, and can seize or reroll initiative by landing a blow without doing damage.
quotes: may add a bonus of equal to or less than their Finesse score to their Initiative roll

entries.title: Certamen School: Saggitarius (Archer)
entries.summary: A contested technique that boosts Attack Total at an equal cost to Defense but limits damage to a single Fatigue level, useful mainly for first-blow duels.
quotes: the magus may add up to triple their Finesse to their Attack Total, subtracting the same amount from their Defense total.

entries.title: Certamen School: Scissor (Carvers)
entries.summary: A style where the duelist skips an attack in one round and then, on a successful attack, converts the margin into Fatigue levels lost by dividing by a set number.
quotes: (Weaking Total – Resistance Total) / 3 = Number of fatigue levels lost.

entries.title: Certamen School: Velitus (Spear)
entries.summary: A style that wears down the opponent's Resistance Total by declining to do damage after landing a blow, based on the duelist's Finesse score.
quotes: A velitus who lands a blow and declines to do damage reduces their foe's Resistance total by one half of the velitus's Finesse score, rounded down.

entries.title: The Mercurian Rituals (overview)
entries.requires: Access to Mercurian Ritual Lab Texts
entries.summary: Introduces the Cult of Mercury's non-Hermetic ritual Lab Texts and the translation work needed to reinvent them as Hermetic rituals.

entries.title: Reading the Mercurian Rituals
entries.requires: Latin and Magic Theory; Mercurian Lab Texts
entries.summary: A brief reading of a Mercurian Lab Text reveals its Technique, Form, magnitude and general purpose, but does not permit casting or reinvention.
quotes: It takes a day to study each Lab Text in this way

entries.title: Learning the Mercurian Rituals (translating Lab Texts)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Texts and a laboratory
entries.summary: Procedure for translating non-Hermetic Mercurian Lab Texts into Hermetic ones over several seasons, accumulating points from the Lab Total, before inventing the ritual normally.
quotes: When the character has accumulated points equal to twice the level of the ritual he has translated it.
In order to translate the ritual in a single season, the magus requires a Lab Total equal to three times the ritual level.

entries.title: Casting the Mercurian Rituals
entries.summary: Once translated and invented, Mercurian rituals are cast and dispelled as Hermetic rituals, though their non-Hermetic origin is visible to those with Magic Theory.
quotes: he can cast them as if they were Hermetic rituals of the appropriate Arts

entries.title: Hermetic Versions of the Mercurian Rituals
entries.summary: Introduces the list of recoverable Cult of Mercury rituals that can be reinvented as non-Hermetic Hermetic rituals.

entries.title: Purification (Mercurian ritual)
entries.summary: A CrCo ritual that reduces another character's apparent age and Decrepitude and removes Aging Points; it breaks the Hermetic Limit of Aging.
quotes: The target's apparent age is reduced by 5 years and his Decrepitude Score is reduced by 1.
This ritual breaks the Hermetic Limit of Aging.

entries.title: The Scrying Pool (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: The Scrying Pool; the pool in the Scrying Office
entries.summary: An InIm ritual tied to one specific pool that has a special interaction with Wizard's Communion, letting participants take shifts to prolong the scrying.
quotes: The ritual is specifically designed for this pool; another similar pool cannot be used.
Casting this spell on a member of Order of Hermes is illegal scrying.

entries.title: Penetrate the Regio Skin (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: Penetrate the Regio Skin
entries.summary: A ritual that creates a new, small entrance through a Magic regio boundary, with a roll to control the entrance location.
quotes: a successful Dex + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 6 is required to precisely control where the entrance physically is

entries.title: Blessing of Mercury (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: Blessing of Mercury; consecrated temple of Mercury
entries.summary: A yearlong ritual cast in a consecrated temple of Mercury that boosts the target's Casting and Laboratory totals.
quotes: The target gains +3 to all Casting and Laboratory totals for the duration of the spell.

entries.title: Transformation of Flesh to Spirit (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: Transformation of Flesh to Spirit; consecrated temple of Mercury
entries.summary: A sacrificial ritual in which the caster dies to permanently raise the Magic aura of a temple, subject to requirements on the caster's Art Scores and Penetration.
quotes: the caster must have no Art Score with a value less than twice the current aura level

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.8 Trianoma

entries.title: Wizard's Initiation (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: Wizard's Initiation; consecrated temple of Mercury
entries.summary: A ritual meant to grant The Gift that no longer works; casting it always fails and adds an extra botch die.
quotes: The target of this ritual gains The Gift.

entries.title: Consecration of Mercury's House (Mercurian ritual)
entries.requires: Mercurian Lab Text: Consecration of Mercury's House
entries.summary: A ritual that consecrates a temple to Mercury, creating a permanent low-level Magic aura and the consecration needed for other Mercurian rituals, at a cost of Faith Points for those inside.
quotes: This creates a level 1 Magic aura within the temple precinct

entries.title: Integration of the Mercurian Rituals (new ritual guidelines)
entries.summary: Describes integration breakthroughs that would add new ritual guidelines (creating or raising Magic auras and opening regio entrances) and the Mercurian Magic Virtue, with Breakthrough Points required and insight sources.
quotes: Breakthrough Points Required: 30.
This requires 45 Breakthrough points.

related.text: Hedge Magic Revised Edition p.14 Integration

entries.title: Repairing the Wizard's Initiation Ritual (research project)
entries.summary: Explains why the ritual that grants The Gift fails and the integration project, with its Breakthrough Point cost and new guideline, that could repair it.
quotes: that requires 60 Breakthrough points and adds the following guideline

related.text: Hedge Magic Revised Edition p.14 Integration

entries.title: Advancing the Antagonists (Aetheric Magic after the breakthrough)
entries.requires: Storyguide running the End of Time chapter
entries.summary: After the breakthrough the antagonist Andreva gains the Aetheric Magic Virtue and the Form of Aether, and the Virtue is then initiated out to Criamon magi and willing allies who gain the Form at a score of zero.
quotes: This grants the new Form of Aether but at a score of zero.

entries.title: Interrupting the Criamon Ritual
entries.requires: Storyguide running the End of Time chapter
entries.summary: Describes what happens if the characters violently interrupt House Criamon's great ritual: an immediate casting roll as if the ritual had finished, with a possible massive botch whose effects the storyguide decides.
quotes: although this is with 30 botch dice due to the magnitude of the ritual and the pawns of vis being used

entries.title: Designing the Ritual: Hold the Sky in Thrall
entries.summary: Gives the two Aether effects needed for the ending ritual: a sight effect to perceive aether and a unique ritual to stop its motion, with level builds and the Required Lab Total for different numbers of seasons.
quotes: (Base 5, +3 Sight, +5 density, +20 size)
Required Lab Total: 4 seasons (182), 8 seasons (164), 12 seasons (158), 16 seasons (153), 20 seasons (152)

entries.title: Initiation Script: Aetheric Magic
entries.summary: The initiation script for learning Aetheric Magic from House Criamon: a journey to Megiddo, paid tuition, a Criamon stigma that gives the Disfigured Flaw, and a vow to spread the knowledge.
quotes: Target Level: 21
Script Bonus: +13

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults (initiation scripts)

entries.title: Hermetic Breakthrough: Aetheric Magic
entries.summary: The 100-point Hermetic Breakthrough that creates the Form of Aether: research must come from projects tied to each Technique, and completion grants the Aetheric Magic Major Hermetic Virtue with Aether bought from the converted experience points.
quotes: a minimum of 20 points must be gained from projects associated with each of the Hermetic Techniques
the new Art of Aether at a starting score of 13 with a further nine experience points left over.

entries.title: Aetheric Magic Virtue and the Form of Aether
entries.summary: The Aetheric Magic Major Hermetic Virtue grants the Form of Aether, which combines with every Technique like any other Form, with the usual rules for rituals.
quotes: The Major Hermetic Virtue of Aetheric Magic grants knowledge of the new Hermetic Form of Aether.

entries.title: Aetheric Spells and Magic Resistance
entries.summary: Spells that create aether must still penetrate Magic Resistance, but magi lacking the Form of Aether get no Form bonus to Magic Resistance or soak against aether; aether suits offense poorly and few attack spells exist.
quotes: magi without knowledge of the Form of Aether do not receive any Form bonus either as part of their Magic Resistance or as a soak bonus to reduce any damage received.

entries.title: Endurance of the Witch Moon (fallback Witch Moon rule)
entries.requires: Aetheric research project; Hedge Magic: Revised Edition optional
entries.summary: A research spell that forces a target to endure the Witch Moon, with a fallback procedure for troupes without the hedge magic rules: a fever, a month without the Gift, and a Stamina-based roll each month to end it, with failures adding Warping.
quotes: To End Witch Moon: Stamina – Warping Score + stress die vs Ease Factor 6

related.text: Hedge Magic: Revised Edition p.42 Witch Moon

entries.title: Arcane Knowledge: Aether Books and Lunar Lore
entries.requires: Access to the Criamon aetheric library
entries.summary: The aetheric library's tractatus and summae can each be studied as a source of insight toward the Form of Aether breakthrough, and the new Lunar Lore Ability has no books and no knowledge of the Lunar realm until after the first fall.
quotes: Each of these twelve volumes may be studied as a source of insight (as per the rules in Ancient Magic)

entries.title: The Form of Aether (Ae)
entries.summary: Describes the new Form of Aether: the base Individual by density of aether, the east-to-west motion and speed of aether at each density, the associated Magic Realm Province, and the Form bonus for soaking aether damage and resisting its influence on the humors.
quotes: Form Bonus: Soak against damage inflicted by aether, rolls to resist the influence of aether on the humors.
one pace per round for a density of metal, ten paces per round for stone, 100 paces for earth, 1,000 for water, 10,000 for fire, 100,000 for air, and 1,000,000 for intangible aether

related.text: ArM5 Realms of Power: Magic p.24 Provinces

entries.title: Investigating Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Insight requires studying both a defixio and a formula from each of five cult specialties, with a bonus when both come from the same cult; an Intellego Vim spell reveals the details of an active defixio.
quotes: the magus adds +3 to his Insight roll
An Intellego Vim spell (base level 4) reveals

entries.title: Integrating Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Spells invented while integrating defixio magic must be Rituals, use the cult's Art combination, and are flawed until the Breakthrough; Event Duration and Unlimited Range need different breakthrough totals, with each cult limited to a fifth of the points.
quotes: The magus must make a Minor Breakthrough (30 breakthrough points) for Event Duration and a Hermetic Breakthrough (60 breakthrough points) for Unlimited Range.

entries.title: New Duration: Event
entries.summary: A Ritual-only Duration that holds the spell in abeyance until a described condition occurs; it requires an Intellego requisite, interacts with Magic Resistance and Aegis, depends on the casting range for detection, and adds to the spell's magnitude.
quotes: This Duration is only available for Ritual spells.
Any spell that uses the Event Duration must have an Intellego requisite.
The Event Duration adds +1 to the magnitude of the spell cast.

entries.title: Event Duration Examples
entries.summary: Worked examples of building Event Duration spells, showing how the trigger and aim determine requisites and Range, and noting that such a spell causes no Warping but cannot move.
quotes: thus does not cause Warping

entries.title: New Range: Unlimited
entries.summary: A Ritual-only Range that reaches any distance if the caster has sympathetic connections to the target totaling a minimum bonus, but needs no Arcane Connection.
quotes: This range is only available for Ritual spells.
This Range adds +6 to the magnitude of the spell or, for spell guidelines that require an Arcane Connection, it adds +2 magnitudes to the base.

entries.title: Unlimited Range Examples
entries.summary: Worked examples of Unlimited Range spells, including how a guideline that needed an Arcane Connection is converted by replacing it with a sympathetic connection and adding magnitudes.
quotes: adds +2 magnitudes to the final level of the spell

entries.title: Naming Conventions
entries.summary: Summarizes how names are given and used among Christians, Muslims and Jews, as background for deciding which names can serve as sympathetic connections in defixio and Unlimited Range magic.

entries.title: Religious Names in Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Birth names, nicknames and bynames work as sympathetic connections, but baptismal, laqab and rabbinical names do not and can cause the spell to fail or to be treated as if only a pseudonym were known.
quotes: the spell always fails

entries.title: Using Duration Event
entries.summary: Advice on Event Duration spells as traps and alarms: require the player to write down the exact trigger and totals, beware accidental Code of Hermes violations, and note the side effects of casting without Penetration.
quotes: The storyguide should always require the player to write out a complete description of the triggering event and record the relevant spell totals.

entries.title: Using Range Unlimited
entries.summary: Advice on Unlimited Range spells: the magus must create the symbolic representation himself, inaccurate maps or pictures fail, locations never visited raise troupe questions, and a storyguide may cap the distance.
quotes: A magus must create any symbolic representation used as a sympathetic connection in an Unlimited Range spell

entries.title: The End of All Moments
entries.summary: When the ritual completes, the spheres stop and all active Hermetic effects are canceled, as when crossing into the Magic Realm; spells relying on celestial-linked Durations fail again when recast, and the storyguide decides what time of day the region is stuck in.
quotes: all active effects are suddenly canceled

entries.title: Magic After the Apocalypse
entries.summary: Introduces the new Lunar Realm and explains that, with the spheres stopped, spells and device effects with Sun, Moon or Year Duration fail unless altered by Flexible Formulaic Magic or similar.
quotes: Spells and device effects relying on Sun, Moon, or Year Duration become obsolete and fail.

entries.title: Impact on Hermetic Magic
entries.summary: Summarises three ways Hermetic magic is hampered after the apocalypse: the hostile Lunar realm, failing celestial Durations, and the loss of the Aegis of the Hearth and Parma Magica.
quotes: the Aegis of the Hearth ritual and even the Parma Magica, which are tied to the Year and Sun Durations, do not function

entries.title: Durations After the Apocalypse
entries.summary: Notes that Hermetic Durations tied to the heavens no longer work and points to a table of which Durations still function and which are unusable, with replacements researchable.
quotes: The nearby table shows which Durations still function correctly and those that are beyond use.

entries.title: Parma Magica and the Aegis of the Hearth After the Apocalypse
entries.summary: With the Sun and Year Durations disrupted, the Parma Magica and Aegis of the Hearth both fail until the Order researches new Durations and new versions of those rituals.
quotes: The Sun and Year Durations are both disrupted once the lunar sphere falls.

entries.title: New Lunar Durations
entries.summary: Replacement Durations that do not depend on the moving heavens (Burning of a Taper, At the Waking or the Sleeping, 300 Miles, The Weight of Years), each needing a Minor Breakthrough to formalize; improvising a non-standard Duration without the breakthrough raises its effective magnitude.
quotes: each requiring a Minor Breakthrough and around 30 Breakthrough Points (or 150 levels of experimental effects)
but the Duration is considered one magnitude greater than it would have been had it been formalized through research.

entries.title: Summary of Durations after the Apocalypse
entries.summary: A table showing which standard Durations still work (Momentary, Ring, Concentration) and which fail (Diameter, Sun, Moon, Year) after the heavens stop, with the alternative Duration for each; other traditions' Durations are judged against it.
quotes: Durations granted by mystery cults or other traditions should be judged against this list.

entries.title: Exotic Magic and Supernatural Beasts after the Apocalypse
entries.summary: Non-Hermetic traditions suffer the same Duration limits as Hermetic magi, but the powers of supernatural beasts are unaffected even when they reference a disabled Duration.
quotes: For the most part, the powers of supernatural beasts are unaffected by the Apocalypse.

entries.title: Infernal and Divine Powers after the Apocalypse
entries.summary: Infernal and Divine Powers keep working normally; only aura-interaction penalties apply to them.
quotes: Infernal and Divine Powers are unaffected by the Apocalypse, with the exception of any aura-interaction penalties.

entries.title: Regiones and the Supernatural Realms as Refuge
entries.summary: Magi can shelter from the apocalypse in deep regiones or by withdrawing into the Magic or Faerie Realms, where Hermetic magic works again, while the Divine and Infernal Realms offer no return.
quotes: Magi who withdraw to the Magic Realm find that their command over Hermetic magic returns to them

entries.title: Beguile Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guideline table by level for Beguile effects: altering memories, perceptions and emotions, planting suggestions, commands and total control.
quotes: Completely control the target, including its movement and communication.

entries.title: Conjure Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Conjure effects: extra magnitudes for intricate or controllable glamours and for changing animate to inanimate, conjuring faeries, and changing targets into glamours by Size.
quotes: Conjure a faerie with Faerie Might equal to the base level of this effect.

entries.title: Dream Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Dream effects: remote senses, mental communication, understanding speech, reading thoughts and memories, and answering questions about the likely future over increasing time spans.
quotes: Treat the target as if it possessed the Premonitions Ability for the duration, with a score of (the base level of this effect / 5).

entries.title: Grant Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Grant effects: restoring Faerie Might, giving the target a power, temporary Sympathy Traits, Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, and temporary Faerie auras or regiones.
quotes: The target faerie regains a number of Faerie Might Points equal to (the base level of this effect + 5) for the duration.

entries.title: Portage Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Portage effects: moving targets through regio boundaries into or out of the Faerie Realm by level, instant transport to Sympathy Trait objects, and changes to movement speed and Fatigue.
quotes: Transport the target through a regio boundary to a regio with a level less than or equal to ((the base level of this effect + 15) / 5).

entries.title: Ware Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Ware effects: suppressing supernatural effects, wards against things by Might limit depending on the caster's positive, negative or any Sympathy Traits, and bonuses to Soak and Defense.
quotes: Ward the target against anything associated with one of the caster's positive Sympathy Traits, with Faerie Might no greater than (the base level of this effect + 20).

entries.title: Weal Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Weal effects: bonuses and penalties to Recovery and Aging rolls, healing wounds for the duration, shortening wound recovery intervals, and reducing apparent age.
quotes: Give the target a bonus to Recovery rolls and a penalty to Aging rolls, or a bonus to Aging rolls and a penalty to Recovery rolls, equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3)

entries.title: Woe Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Woe effects: penalties to Recovery or Aging rolls, Fatigue loss, wounds at each severity for the duration, lengthened wound recovery intervals and forced Aging rolls.
quotes: Give the target a penalty to Recovery or Aging rolls equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3).

entries.title: Adjuration Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Adjuration effects such as dispelling, warding, binding and compelling supernatural creatures.
quotes: Dispel magic, infernal, or faerie effects of level less than (this effect level + 10).

entries.title: Blessing Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Blessing effects such as Magic Resistance, bonuses to virtuous tasks, recovery and aging bonuses.
quotes: Give a person, object, or area Magic Resistance equal to (the level of the effect + 15), which is not cumulative with other forms of resistance.

entries.title: Cursing Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Cursing effects such as reducing Might, imposing penalties, wounding, disease and instant death.
quotes: Reduce a supernatural creature's Might by (the level of the effect + 10), assuming you overcome its resistance.

entries.title: Intervention Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Intervention effects such as perceiving supernatural effects, transforming or mending things, healing wounds, creating regiones and raising the dead.
quotes: Create a terrestrial regio at level 1. Adding five levels increases the level by one, or adds an extra layer.

entries.title: Transcendence Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Transcendence effects such as protection from spells, extra Soak, ignoring penalties and postponing or resolving aging crises.
quotes: You cannot be targeted by spells or powers less than (the level of this effect + 5).
increasing Soak by (the magnitude of the effect + 3)

entries.title: Understanding Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Understanding effects such as visions, advice, enhanced memory and prophecy.
quotes: Reduce the number of botch dice you must roll by the magnitude of this effect

entries.title: Wonders Guidelines
entries.summary: Effect-level guidelines for Wonders effects such as creating plants, forces of nature, food, objects and animals.
quotes: Create a dangerous substance, like fire or poison, that does +(base level of the spell) damage upon contact.

entries.title: Ptolemaic coordinates versus Arcane Connections
entries.requires: Ptolemaic coordinates integrated into Hermetic theory
entries.summary: Explains how coordinates work as Arcane Connections that rely on the Law of Names: they do not fade, can be carried in the mind, written down or built into items, and can be shared without being lost.
quotes: They are information rather than objects, so they can be given away, and yet retained by the giver.
They do not need to be collected from a place, because they rely on the Law of Names, not the Law of Contagion.

entries.title: Using Magical Coordinates
entries.summary: Overview of integrating Ptolemaic coordinates into Hermetic magic: learn to measure the array of fixed stars, then calibrate the system by observing the array at the origin point. No new Virtue or Ability is needed and the technique can be taught.
quotes: As soon as a character has completed the tasks required to reconstruct Ptolemy's work, it can be applied immediately to Hermetic magic, and may be taught to others.

entries.title: Deriving Coordinates
entries.summary: The three ways a character can learn the coordinates of a place (stellar observation, other astronomers' observations, spellcasting), and the note that known coordinates can be used day or night, indoors or underground.
quotes: A character does not require starlight to use coordinates; the character can use known coordinates during the day, from inside buildings, or underground.

entries.title: Observation of the Fixed Stars
entries.summary: How to derive a place's coordinates by astronomical observation: an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll with a clear sky, simple tools and time for calculation (shortened by supernaturally accurate timepieces or Ptolemy's tables). It cannot work without the array of fixed stars at the origin.
quotes: A character who makes an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll against an Ease Factor of 15 makes an accurate observation.

entries.title: Learning Coordinates from Other Astronomers
entries.summary: Coordinates can be taken from Ptolemy's published lists, but their accuracy varies by region, being excellent near Alexandria, often good within the old Western Roman Empire and poor beyond it.
quotes: His coordinates for places around Alexandria are perfect, and those within the borders of the fallen Western Roman Empire are often correct to within a few miles.

entries.title: Stellar Measurement by Spellcasting
entries.requires: Ptolemaic coordinates plus the Celestial Magic Mystery
entries.summary: Magi with the Celestial Magic Mystery can measure coordinates by spell instead of by eye; the sample spell shows the effect and notes how precisely a magus can hold a coordinate in mind.
quotes: A magus is unable to hold coordinates in her mind with sufficient precision to represent a circle less than 1000 paces across.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Chapter 6: Hermetic Astrology (Celestial Magic)

entries.title: The Problem of the Origin Point
entries.summary: Characters cannot use the system until they know the array of fixed stars at the origin point, which they must infer from stellar readings, including one taken on the Zero Longitude in the Purple Islands.
quotes: The characters require three stellar readings.

entries.title: Astrological Durations
entries.summary: Defines the astrological units of time (Minute, Hour, Day, Sign) that Celestial Magic can use for spell Durations and says an Astronomy roll is required.
quotes: An Astrological Minute for spells is the same as a Hermetic Diameter Duration
Using Astrological Durations requires a roll of Astronomy.

entries.title: Limits on the Use of Astrological Time
entries.summary: Astrological conditions are only uniform within about 500 paces of the point of measurement, which limits the area and Target Size of astrological spells.
quotes: conditions are essentially identical over an area extending approximately 500 paces in all directions from the point of measurement

entries.title: New Duration: Minutes = Diameter
entries.summary: The four astrological Durations (Minutes=Diameter, Hours=Sun, Days=Moon, Signs=Year/Ritual), the Astronomy roll needed for each, and what happens when the calculation fails or botches.
quotes: Die Roll + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. 6 + Number of Diameters Desired
Die roll + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. 6 + Number of Hours Desired
The maximum duration is one year, regardless of all other factors.

entries.title: Favorable Hour for Spellcasting
entries.summary: The magus can identify one favorable hour per day for a casting bonus of +1 to +5, with a roll against three times the desired bonus and a penalty equal to the bonus if botched.
quotes: Only one hour in any day will favor the maga.
Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. Three Times Desired Bonus

entries.title: Options: Calculating an Astrological Duration
entries.summary: Optional modifiers to the Astronomy Ease Factor: a Daily Horoscope, exact astrological time, precision end time, an armillary sphere, or non-stress calculation.
quotes: Calculate Daily Horoscope: Subtract 3 from Ease Factor
Precision Astrology (Specify Exact End Time): Add 3 to Ease Factor
Consult a Magical Armillary Sphere: Halve the Adjusted Ease Factor (after all Additions and Subtractions)

entries.title: The Time of Favorable Hour
entries.summary: A quick dice procedure for the storyguide to decide which hour of the day is favorable instead of using astrological tables.
quotes: then divide by 4 (round up)

entries.title: Performance Magic, In Brief
entries.summary: Abbreviated rules for the Performance Magic Virtue: disguising spellcasting with a performed Ability, recognizing the Form of such a spell, and a new Performance Duration for spells.
quotes: Recognize Form of Performance Magic Spell: stress die + Perception + Awareness + effect magnitude vs. Ease Factor 15
Cast a Performance Duration Spell: die roll + Ability's Characteristic + Ability vs. Ease Factor 3

entries.title: Performance Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus replace Hermetic words and gestures with the actions or words of a chosen mundane Ability, concealing spellcasting; covers which Abilities can be chosen and how normal casting adjustments still apply to components not replaced.
quotes: You may not choose any Language, Supernatural, Academic, or Arcane Ability.
Words or gestures that are not being replaced by Performance Magic remain as normal mystical components of spellcasting

entries.title: Performance Abilities
entries.summary: Lists which Abilities qualify for Performance Magic and the special stress die with extra botch dice needed to use a martial Ability while in combat.
quotes: the player rolls a stress die with three extra botch dice, and treats all non-botches as die rolls of zero

entries.title: Sorcerous Music (Performance Magic)
entries.summary: Special rules for Performance Magic (Music): song or an instrument can replace gestures and/or words, and Voice Range carries as far as the music can be heard.
quotes: cannot be performed silently

entries.title: Recognizing Performance Magic
entries.summary: Gives the Ease Factor adjustments for other magi trying to determine the Form of a spell cast with mundane words or gestures.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + Awareness vs. 15 – effect magnitude
–3 if Hermetic words are spoken (and can be heard)
+3 if both words and gestures are mundane

entries.title: New Duration for Performance Magic
entries.summary: Defines the Performance Duration, equivalent to Concentration, and the roll needed to start a spell with it; no further Concentration rolls are needed while the performance continues.
quotes: Performance is equivalent to Concentration Duration.
Characteristic (varies with Ability) + Ability against an Ease Factor of 3.

entries.title: Spell Binding — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Explains how a spell is bound into a physical container with a general Ritual spell so a trapped lesser spirit sustains it indefinitely, including what spells can be bound and how the container spell is timed.
quotes: The spell to be sustained cannot be a Ritual spell, nor have a duration of Momentary.
The base level of this container ritual must equal or exceed the spell to be sustained.

entries.title: Suitable Spirits
entries.summary: Which spirits can be bound to sustain a spell: disembodied spirits with sufficient Might, thematically linked to the spell and of the same realm as the magus's magic.
quotes: must have a Might at least equal to the level of the spell to be sustained

entries.title: Spirit, Spell and Container Combined
entries.summary: What a bound spirit can and cannot do, how the spell fails if the container is broken or the spirit's Might drops, and the level of spell needed to command the spirit out.
quotes: If the spirit's Might falls below the level of the spell, the sustained spell fails
Such a spell must have a level that exceeds the level of the container spell that binds both the spell and spirit

entries.title: Virtue: Spell Binding (spirit-sustained spells)
entries.summary: A Ritual spell guideline combines a second spell with a bound spirit in a physical container so the second spell is maintained indefinitely while the spirit remains bound.
quotes: the spirit's Might must at least equal the sustained spell's level

entries.title: Sustain a Spell of (Form)
entries.summary: The General ReVi Ritual guideline that entwines another spell with a container so a bound spirit of sufficient Might sustains it indefinitely.
quotes: The base level of this spell must equal or exceed the level of the spell to be sustained.

entries.title: Bound Spirits (command spells made permanent; countermanding bindings)
entries.summary: A worked example of using Spell Binding to make a command spell permanent, which cheaply keeps a spirit bound and lets the container grant command. It also states what is needed to countermand an existing command effect or end a binding by breaking the container.
quotes: a countermanding spell must exceed the level of the original, and also penetrate the Magic Resistance of the spirit

entries.title: Magic Realm Magic
entries.requires: Minor Breakthrough (Magic Realm Magic), researched after visiting the Magic Realm
entries.summary: Hermetic magic works in the Magic Realm but cannot normally affect boundaries or vestiges; a Minor Breakthrough opens new guidelines, which a magus can pursue by converting vis gathered in the Realm into an Insight, or learn from a Lab Text.
quotes: For every pawn of vis he converts into an Insight, the associated effect has one magnitude.
A magus may only gain one Insight per season.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26

entries.title: New Creo Guidelines (Magic Realm)
entries.summary: Creo guidelines for creating boundaries, increasing existing boundaries and creating vestiges in the Magic Realm.
quotes: General: Create a boundary in a part of the Magic Realm that has no boundary, with a score equal to (the magnitude of the effect – 4)

entries.title: New Intellego Guidelines (Magic Realm)
entries.summary: Intellego guidelines for detecting vestiges and boundaries and for perceiving the Twilight Void to ease a Travel roll.
quotes: Level 4: Perceive the Twilight Void through a target vestige or boundary. This gives the caster a +3 bonus to his Travel roll

entries.title: New Muto Guidelines (Magic Realm)
entries.summary: Muto guidelines for changing the Form of a boundary or vestige, associating a target with the Magic Realm, and making things perceptible as vestiges.
quotes: Level 10: Associate a target with the Magic Realm, as if it had Magic Might of the same Form as this effect.

entries.title: New Perdo Guidelines (Magic Realm)
entries.summary: Perdo guidelines for temporarily destroying vestiges, removing a target to the Twilight Void, and permanently reducing a boundary.
quotes: Level 10: Remove a target to the Twilight Void for the duration

entries.title: New Rego Guidelines (Magic Realm)
entries.summary: Rego guidelines for moving a target between provinces, shortening a journey through the Twilight Void, and instantly transporting a target through a vestige or boundary.
quotes: Level 10: Reduce the length of a target's journey through the Twilight Void by one step.

entries.title: Turbulence
entries.summary: Introduces Turbulences, uncontrolled magical outbursts from a Gifted child's emotional distress.
quotes: Hermetic magi refer to these displays as Turbulences

entries.title: Incurring a Turbulence
entries.summary: When a Gifted child botches a stressful activity involving magic, a roll against the storyguide's stress die, and also against the character's age, determines whether a Turbulence occurs.
quotes: To see if a character incurs a Turbulence the player rolls the character's Intelligence + a stress die + Aura against the storyguide's roll of a stress die (no botch).
INCURRING A TURBULENCE: Intelligence + stress die + Aura vs. Higher of stress die (no botch) and character's age

entries.title: Controlling Turbulences
entries.summary: A Stamina roll against the character's Warping Score decides whether the child controls a Turbulence; the difference of the two totals, halved, sets the magnitude of the effect.
quotes: CONTROLLING A TURBULENCE: Stamina + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die
CONTROLLED TURBULENCE MAGNITUDE: Stamina + stress die total – Warping Score + stress die total/2
UNCONTROLLED TURBULENCE MAGNITUDE: Warping Score + stress die total – Stamina + stress die total/2

entries.title: Effects of Turbulence
entries.summary: Describes what Technique and Form a Turbulence takes, how it interacts with Magic Resistance and Penetration, how a child can deliberately force one by spending a Confidence point, and how Turbulences fade as the child ages.
quotes: TURBULENCE PENETRATION: Penetration Ability times (1 + sympathetic multiplier)
The player must spend a Confidence point, at which point he checks to incur a Turbulence

entries.title: Turbulences and the Aegis of the Hearth
entries.summary: Sidebar on how a covenant's Aegis of the Hearth affects a child's Turbulence depending on whether the child took part in the Aegis ritual, plus the invitation-token debate for apprentices.
quotes: Subtract half the level of the Aegis of the Hearth spell from the roll the player makes to incur a Turbulence.

entries.title: Laboratory Turbulences
entries.summary: A young apprentice may have to check for a Turbulence midway through a stressful laboratory season; an uncontrolled one cuts the apprentice's contribution to the Lab Total.
quotes: if it is uncontrolled, reduce the Apprentice's Lab Total aid by half

entries.title: Miasma Sizes (Targeting Spells at Miasmas)
entries.summary: Rules for sizing a miasma as about an acre per Auram Individual target, with each magnitude of added size covering ten times more area, and how larger covenant-sized miasmas need spells raised.
quotes: one target: Individual is a miasma the size of an acre of land
need to be increased by two magnitudes to affect the miasma

entries.title: Form Ceases to Work: The Herbam Death Moon
entries.summary: Fourth month: formulaic and spontaneous spells of the destroyed Form only work if vis is spent, and lab work with that Form also costs extra vis.
quotes: one pawn per magnitude of the spell
it costs 1 pawn of vis for every two magnitudes (10 levels) of final effect

entries.title: Protective Walls Against Miasmas
entries.summary: Compares the height of a miasma to real walls and towers to show why a barrier must be very tall and must include a portal to expel miasmas generated inside.
quotes: A miasma is approximately 60 paces high

entries.title: Seeing, Moving and Destroying Miasmas (Spell Design)
entries.summary: Design guidance for spells that view, move or destroy miasmas: an Intellego Vim base, a Form requisite that adds no magnitude, Rego Auram to move them and Perdo Auram with Vim and Form requisites to destroy them, treating a miasma as a severe weather phenomenon.
quotes: The Intellego Vim base level is 3.
A necessary condition of viewing a miasma, and affecting it with magic in general, is to include a Form-specific requisite.

entries.title: Inventing the Great Barrier (Ward Against the Great Pestilence)
entries.summary: Explains designing a general ward against the Great Pestilence once Magic Realm magic is integrated, with a Penetration Total that must exceed the creature's effective Magic Resistance.
quotes: The Great Pestilence has a Might of 50 and the Form province adds +10 to its Magic Resistance for a total of 60.

entries.title: New Arcane Ability: Craft Poppets
entries.summary: A new Arcane Ability for making effigies that house an arcane connection and act as a sympathetic connection, with ease factors for simple and permanent poppets.
quotes: A simple effigy is good for one use, takes an hour to make, and requires a Dexterity + Craft Poppets roll against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: Preserving Arcane Connections
entries.summary: An apothecary can lengthen the lifespan of an organic arcane connection once, using a Dexterity plus Profession roll against an ease factor that depends on its original duration.
quotes: Make a Dexterity + Profession: Apothecary roll, and consult the following table:

entries.title: Leadworker (Katadesmoi and Penetration Bonuses)
entries.requires: Virtue: Leadworker (Minor, Hermetic); House Tremere tradition
entries.summary: Explains the leadworker's curse tablets and figurines and gives Penetration bonus table additions for a katadesmos tablet, a kolossos, and a kolossos containing a sympathetic connection, plus a free fixed Arcane Connection created from body material.
quotes: Katadesmos tablet, inscribed with the name of a victim (+2)
A Kolossos constructed with a sympathetic connection from the body of the victim imbedded in it (+3)

entries.title: The Altars of Alexander the Great (Arcane Connections)
entries.summary: The altars are linked by dragon lines; casting an Arcane Connection Range spell while touching one treats the other linked shrines, cities and temples as having an Arcane Connection with a bonus multiplier.
quotes: is considered to have an Arcane Connection with a +4 multiplier to the other shrines, cities, or temples connected by the dragon lines.

entries.title: Open Body: Arcane Connections to Faeries
entries.summary: Speaking to, eating the food of, bleeding near, or having sex with a faerie opens a human to its glamour and creates a temporary Arcane Connection with a stated Penetration multiplier; pregnancy by a faerie creates a longer-lasting one.
quotes: Speaking to a faerie creates an Arcane Connection to that faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 2 that endures until the conversation ends.
A character whose blood is taken or tasted by a faerie has an Arcane Connection to that Faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 3 until the wound heals.
Intercourse with a faerie creates an Arcane Connection to that faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 4 during the intercourse.

related.text: Chapter 3: Faerie Characters, Traditional and Sovereign Wards

entries.title: Potent Magic
entries.summary: Reproduces the Potent Magic Hermetic Virtue, which gives a bonus in a narrow field like a Magical Focus and lets the magus design Potent spells. Several mysteries in this book rely on it.
quotes: grants a +3 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Scores
grants a +6 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Scores

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonus table

entries.title: Potent Magic — Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Gives a narrow-field (Minor) or wide-field (Major) bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score and the ability to invent Potent spells; compatible with a Magical Focus and can be taken more than once for different areas.
quotes: Minor Potent Magic covers the same narrow fields as a Minor Magical Focus, and grants a +3 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score.
Major Potent Magic covers the same wide fields as a Major Magical Focus, and grants a +6 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score.

entries.title: Potent Spells
entries.requires: Virtue: Potent Magic (to design); any magus may learn one
entries.summary: Defines Potency as the sum of Shape and Material bonuses of the Casting Items built into a spell, added to the Casting Score; Potency is capped by Magic Theory and the caster must touch the Casting Items.
quotes: Potency Score = Sum of Bonus from each Casting Item
Potency Bonus: Add Potency to Casting Score
a magus may not invent a Potent spell with a Potency higher than his Magic Theory score

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonuses

versions.title: Potent Spells
versions.requires: Virtue: Potent Magic to design; any magus may learn and cast one
versions.summary: A Potent spell has a Potency bonus built from Casting Items that the caster must touch, added to the Casting Score. Potency is part of the spell design and travels with Lab Texts and teaching.
quotes: Potency = Sum of bonus from each Casting Item
Potency Bonus: Add Potency to Casting Score
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonus table

entries.title: Potent Magic and Potent Spells
entries.summary: How a Potent Magic magus designs new Potent spells or variants with different Casting Items, as if from a Lab Text, and writes Lab Texts for them.
quotes: The total Potency may not exceed the magus's Magic Theory.

alsoIn.title: Potent Magic and Potent Spells (Inventing and Varying)

entries.title: Designing Covenant Libraries
entries.summary: At covenant creation, Potency counts toward a Potent spell's level when spending Build Points on Lab Texts.
quotes: add Potency (if any) to spell level when counting Build Points

entries.title: Transitory Magic Items
entries.summary: Introduces single-use items made by Faerie-aligned Egyptian magicians that are not enchanted but carry a supernatural property, commonly temporary amulets and potions.
quotes: A transitory magic item is an object which has supernatural properties, but only for a single use

entries.title: Temporary Amulets (Until Duration)
entries.summary: A temporary amulet is an object carrying a spell with the Faerie-only Until Duration that ends when the amulet is worn and discarded, and the effect survives its creator's death.
quotes: an object on which a spell with the Until Duration has been cast

entries.title: The Statues Just Hold Faeries, They Are Not Enchanted
entries.summary: Merinita view that holy statues, such as a cippus of Horus, are open offers to faeries who feed on the worshipers' hope, rather than enchanted items.
quotes: it's a clever way of making an open offer to nearby faeries

entries.title: Egyptian Seals (temporary magic items)
entries.summary: Seals hold a spell maintained by an Until Duration or act like Watching Wards, triggering when a precondition (usually breaking the seal) is met.
quotes: Egyptian seals of this type are remarkably similar to Watching Wards.

entries.title: Temporary Potions
entries.summary: Potions made by pouring water or beer over a statue housing a faerie (such as a cippus of Horus) or over inscribed bowls, each giving a single effect if a nearby faerie accepts the deal.
quotes: Each statue provided a single effect.

entries.title: Detecting vis with Magic Sensitivity
entries.summary: A character with Magic Sensitivity can tell whether an object holds vis by rolling against an Ease Factor that falls as the vis in it rises.
quotes: make a roll of Perception + Magic Sensitivity against an Ease Factor of (12 — the number of pawns of vis contained in the object)

entries.title: Dedicated Vis in Spell Use
entries.requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
entries.summary: Dedicated vis used to power a spell, Ritual or enchantment of its own Technique and Form is twice as effective, including for botch dice.
quotes: a magus using dedicated vis enjoys a vis boost of +4 per pawn used

entries.title: Cursewood: Poisoned Sap (vis sordida extraction formula)
entries.summary: Once per year a magus may spend a season extracting Perdo vis sordida from the old oak, with the yield set by a formula using the Infernal aura and a risk of Twilight on a double botch.
quotes: collect pawns of Perdo vis sordida equal to (Aura + Intelligence + Infernal Lore + stress die)/5 rounding up.

entries.title: Using vis sordida (tainted vis)
entries.summary: Risks and benefits of using Infernally tainted vis by non-Infernal users: a creeping Wrathful trait, bonuses to casting totals and study Source Quality, extra botch dice, and corrupted levels when preparing items for enchantment.
quotes: Modify casting total by +5 per pawn.
Add three extra botch dice per pawn used
+1 bonus to Source Quality per pawn for studying Hermetic Arts.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.18-19

entries.title: Divine, Infernal, and Faerie Vis (Tainted Vis Substitutes)
entries.summary: Optional rule letting magi replace dwindling Magic vis with Divine, Infernal or Faerie vis, which causes temporary Personality Traits with regular use, extra botch dice per pawn, and realm-flavoured botches.
quotes: Tainted vis adds extra botch dice, 1 per pawn of tainted vis
Abstaining from using tainted vis for six months removes the temporary Personality Trait.

entries.title: Astrological Magical Focus and Potent Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Magical Focus or Potent Magic (astrological)
entries.summary: Allows a Magical Focus or Potent Magic to be defined by a single astrological sign, planet or house; spells that use such a benefit count as Astrological spells.
quotes: Any magus may have a Major Magical Focus or Major Potent Magic covering effects governed by a single astrological sign.

entries.title: Initiating Magic for Birth Sign, Planet, or House
entries.requires: Initiation: astrological Potent Magic or Focus
entries.summary: Relaxes the rule that the Mystagogue must know the Virtue when the Initiate's birth sign, planet or house matches, and gives sympathy bonuses or penalties for matching, other or opposed signs.
quotes: magi Initiating into the magic of their birth have a +1 sympathy bonus for Initiation
causes a penalty of –3

entries.title: Astrological Cyclic Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue or Flaw
entries.summary: Lets Cyclic Magic follow astrological cycles of the zodiac, raising the bonus or penalty when the cycle covers less of the year.
quotes: The bonus or penalty is increased to 5.
The bonus or penalty is increased to 6.

entries.title: (Astrological) Mutable Virtue or Flaw
entries.summary: Lets a Virtue or Flaw apply only in the four mutable signs: Major ones drop to Minor, Minor ones are doubled in intensity.
quotes: the Virtue or Flaw is reduced to being Minor
the effect is doubled in intensity

entries.title: Enchanting a Faerie Familiar
