entries.summary: Rules for binding a faerie being as a familiar, including the Shared Powers, Shared Senses and Shared Fatigue effects and the yearly decay of the cords.
quotes: Each Fatigue Level she spends is worth a number of Might Points equal to (familiar's Might Score / 5).
The familiar may regain (its Might Score / 5) Might Points by resting, just as the maga regain Fatigue Levels.

related.text: ArM5 p.104 Familiar Bonding Lab Total

entries.title: Temporary Familiars
entries.summary: A ritual that binds a supernatural creature as a familiar until a condition ends, with a minimum spell level based on the creature's Might and cords that begin at zero.
quotes: The level of the ritual must be no less than (the creature's Might + 15)
(Base effect, +1 Touch, +4 Until)

entries.title: The Three Faerie Cords
entries.summary: Three negative cords (Leaden, Iron, Tin) bought like the normal cords that balance the positive ones to stop decay, but impose penalties in certain circumstances.
quotes: so long as the sum of the values of one set of cords does not exceed the sum of the scores for the other, the cords do not degrade
add the value of this cord to the number of botch dice you must roll when the maga uses her powers in the Dominion or when touching a holy object

entries.title: Leaden, Iron, and Tin Cords (faerie familiar cords)
entries.summary: Describes the three special negative cords that balance the normal familiar cords for faerie familiars, with their penalties to the magus (and familiar) near Divine auras, iron, or outside supernatural auras.
quotes: The magus rolls this number of additional botch dice when casting within a Divine aura or when touching a holy relic.
If the magus is touching iron, subtract the cord value from all rolls made
subtract the value of the cord from all Personality Trait, healing, deprivation, and aging rolls, and from his Soak total

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.90 Familiar cords

entries.title: Integrating Fertility Magic into Hermetic Theory
entries.requires: Ancient fetish figurine or cave painting
entries.summary: Insight comes from fetish figurines or cave paintings, effects dealing with birth and fertility earn breakthrough points, and there are two separate Breakthroughs, one for the Arcane Ability Fertility Lore and one for the Minor Hermetic Virtue Fertility Ritual Magic.
quotes: The first allows the magus to learn the Arcane Ability Fertility Lore; this is comparatively simple and requires only 15 breakthrough points.
requiring 35 breakthrough points

entries.title: New Target: Unborn Child
entries.summary: A Target available to those with Fertility Ritual Magic that counts as Individual for spell level and lets a magus affect an unborn child, provided he can sense the mother, whose Magic Resistance also protects the child.
quotes: This Target is equivalent to Individual for the purposes of calculating a spell level

entries.title: Hermetic Magic and Mother and Child
entries.summary: Explains that ordinary Hermetic magic can only target a later-term unborn child as a Part of the mother and cannot separate mother and child earlier, a flaw which fertility magic circumvents.
quotes: Mainstream Hermetic magic can target a baby in the second trimester, and onwards until birth, as a Part of the mother

related.text: ArM5 p.112 Parts of an Individual

entries.title: Breakthrough Points from Fetish Creation
entries.summary: A fertile maga who knows Fertility Lore can make her own fetish as an effect earning breakthrough points toward the second fertility Breakthrough, without further Insight; fetishes others make give none.
quotes: as an effect worth 5 breakthrough points towards the second Fertility Magic breakthrough

entries.title: Hedge Wizards and the Aegis of the Hearth
entries.requires: Hedge wizard meeting an Aegis of the Hearth
entries.summary: How a hedge wizard's magic interacts with an Aegis of the Hearth: casting towards it must Penetrate, casting inside it suffers a penalty, and tokens or participation grant immunity.
quotes: half the level of the Aegis is subtracted from his Casting Total

related.text: ArM5 p.161 Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Opening the Arts after a hedge Opening
entries.requires: Apprentice whose Gift was already Opened by a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Adds a penalty to the Intellego Vim Lab Total needed to Open the Hermetic Arts of an apprentice whose Gift has already been Opened by a hedge tradition.
quotes: add 30 to the Intellego Vim Lab Total required by the magus

entries.title: Gruagach Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Lists the Form-specific magic defenses each gruagach Art grants against particular Forms of magic.
quotes: Magical Fortitude: Defense against Corpus effects.
Strength of Form: Defense against Corpus or Animal effects.

entries.title: Learned Magician Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Lists the Form-specific magic defenses each learned magician Art grants against particular Hermetic Forms.
quotes: Defense: Alacritous Fortune

entries.title: Hermetic Viresculture (overview)
entries.summary: Explains Hérisson's breakthrough that lets magi grow self-replicating vis (Stirpes) rather than only harvest static vis (Grana); a Stirps must first be Vitalized and then Invigorated.
quotes: Grana (singular Granum), which is ordinary, static vis; and Stirpes (singular Stirps), which is self-replicating vis

entries.title: New Supernatural Ability: Hermetic Viresculture
entries.summary: Describes the Hermetic Viresculture Ability, which lets a character produce self-reproducing vis and cultivate vis as magical agriculture; it can be taught to magi and only works for those opened to the Hermetic Arts.
quotes: Only those opened to the Hermetic Arts can make use of this Ability since it relies on Hermetic magic.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.29

entries.title: The Stirps
entries.summary: Defines the Stirps, the first individual of a cultivar that holds usable vis and can reproduce; usually a living being, though even a small fire elemental can serve.
quotes: This is the first individual that both contains usable vis and is capable of reproduction, and is the founder of a given cultivar

entries.title: New Cultivars (sidebar)
entries.summary: Suggests further raw materials for Stirpes, such as gemstones that reproduce, elementals for the elemental Forms, and (impractically) Magic Humans.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.83 Magic Humans

entries.title: Withstand Casting — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Reduces the Fatigue lost when casting by one level per level of the Virtue (never below one level lost), with the reduced loss keeping the same short-term or long-term character as normal.
quotes: he loses 1 less Fatigue level than normal, with a minimum of 1 Fatigue level
withstand 1 Fatigue level for each level of the Virtue

entries.title: Withstand Casting and Vulnerable Casting
entries.requires: Virtue: Withstand Casting / Flaw: Vulnerable Casting
entries.summary: A character cannot start with both, but may acquire both in play; the extra loss from Vulnerability is applied first and then withstood.
quotes: You may not start your character with both Vulnerable Casting and Withstand Casting.
apply the extra loss from Vulnerability first, then withstand the increased loss

entries.title: Life Boost and Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Withstand Casting with Life Boost or Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
entries.summary: Explains how Withstand Casting interacts with Virtues that pay for extra spell power with Fatigue: withstanding those levels removes the boost they paid for.
quotes: if he does then he loses the benefits from withstood levels

entries.title: Hex
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to bring ruin on enemies by eye contact, occult signs or an Arcane Connection, with the chosen delay affecting potency.
quotes: There are three ways for her to activate this power

versions.title: Hex (Ability)
versions.summary: Rules for cursing an enemy: three ways to activate the Power, a time frame whose delay modifier affects the roll, a Hex total compared to an Ease Factor table of severities, botch results, and how hexes are removed.
quotes: Hex: stress die + Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + modifiers
roll Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + delay modifier
Treat the hex as having a spell level equal to the number of botch dice it approximates multiplied by 10

entries.title: Hex Delay Modifiers and Roll
entries.summary: Delay modifiers table and Hex roll, including botch consequences, how hexes are removed, and treating a hex as a spell level when dispelling it.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Hex + Aura Bonus + Modifiers
Treat the hex as having a spell level equal to the number of botch dice it approximates, multiplied by 10

entries.title: Hex Effects
entries.summary: Chart of Hex Ease Factors by severity, each comparable to a number of botch dice, with example effects.
quotes: Minor (1 botch)
Terminal (5 botches)

entries.title: Magic Resistance For Church Officers and Sovereigns
entries.summary: Sidebar giving ordained and anointed leaders Magic Resistance by rank, a Soak bonus derived from it, and the effect of excommunication.
quotes: The religious and secular leaders listed below receive a Magic Resistance score as listed here, and a Soak bonus equal to Magic Resistance / 5.

versions.title: Magic Resistance For Church Officers and Sovereigns
versions.summary: Gives set Magic Resistance scores for the pope, cardinals, archbishops and crowned kings, with a Soak bonus and an Aura of Rightful Authority, how excommunication removes them, and how wives and relics add to resistance.
quotes: The religious and secular leaders listed below receive a Magic Resistance score as listed here, and a Soak bonus equal to Resistance / 5.
Excommunication cancels these benefits (but only if the excommunication is God's will).
Wives gain Magic Resistance equal to their husbands.

entries.title: Arma Magica (Parma Folds)
entries.summary: Introduces the Arma Magica folds as Major Breakthroughs built on Parma Magica, and limits how many folds a magus can know and how many students can be taught a fold.
quotes: A magus may know a number of folds equal to his Parma Magica score.

entries.title: Parma Magica Folds
entries.summary: Rules for calculating magic resistance under the folds, and descriptions of the Ablativa, Absorbea, Condensa, Custodia, Repercussa and Restricta variants of Parma Magica with their effects, casting times and restrictions.
quotes: Double a magus's Parma Magica score when calculating magic resistance.
Double the Parma Magica score against the specified Form, but divide it by two (round up) against all others.
The magus adds twice his Parma Magica score to any Defense totals in combat.

entries.title: Healing Blighted Auras (Creo Vim Guideline)
entries.summary: Healing a blighted aura is a Creo Vim ritual with a requisite for the infected Form, using a base derived from the Creo Corpus disease-healing guideline; it repairs blighted vis but does not restore vis already destroyed.
quotes: Healing the aura is a Creo Vim spell, and needs to include a requisite for the infected Form being healed.

entries.title: Curing Diseased Magic Beings
entries.summary: Magic beings sick with the Great Pestilence can be cured with Creo magic of their body type or, through a spell keyed to their Form association, with a stated base level that must be cast as a ritual for permanent healing.
quotes: the base level of the spell is 25

entries.title: New Spell Guideline: Perdo Vim (Destroying Raw Vis) and Leaving the Arcana Centrum
entries.summary: New general Perdo Vim guideline for destroying raw vis equal to the spell level, plus the rule that leaving the Arcana Centrum requires another Twilight Void Travel roll against the same Ease Factor.
quotes: Destroy an amount of raw vis equal to the level of the spell.

entries.title: Realm-Aligned Spells
entries.requires: Saga option: Realm-Aligned Spell Minor Breakthrough
entries.summary: How to invent a spell flavored to the Magic, Faerie or Infernal realm so it is immune to that realm's normal interaction and rolls fewer botch dice, at the cost of a lower Lab Total during invention.
quotes: you reduce your Lab Total by limiting your Magic Theory Ability score to the level of your appropriate Realm Lore

entries.title: Realm-Aligned Spell Interaction Table
entries.requires: Saga option: Realm-Aligned Spell Minor Breakthrough
entries.summary: Table giving the aura bonus or penalty applied to a realm-aligned spell by aura type and spell flavor, replacing the normal Realm Interaction Table.

entries.title: Realm Aligned Spells and Other Techniques
entries.summary: Discusses ways for magi to avoid the aura penalty of the Dominion, including realm-aligned spells as a Hermetic Breakthrough and the work of Conciatta and the learned magicians.
quotes: this is a Minor Breakthrough

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.34

entries.title: Tomb Curses: Condition and Excoriation
entries.summary: Egyptian tomb curses are written enchantments made of a condition that triggers them and one or more excoriations that deliver the penalty; the storyguide decides how literally the condition is read.
quotes: All curses have two parts: a condition and one or more excoriations.

entries.title: Egyptian Talismans (tomb magic)
entries.summary: Describes trigger-based Egyptian talismans, which lack Penetration against humans, can be temporarily deactivated by a particular spell, and can be investigated like item triggers or resolved as narrative traps with a base Ease Factor from the effect's magnitude.
quotes: The base Ease Factor for bypassing a magical trap is equal to (6 + the magnitude of its effect).

entries.title: Egyptian Wards (tomb magic)
entries.summary: Egyptian wards hide tombs or repel intruders, usually with a defined way to deactivate them, may carry Penetration against spirits, and are overcome with the narrative trap rules at a base Ease Factor from the effect's magnitude.
quotes: The base Ease Factor for such actions is (9 + the magnitude of effect).

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Rune Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Rune Magic
entries.summary: After investigating active rune magic, a magus can integrate it into Hermetic theory (a Major Breakthrough) to gain the Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue and the Rune Magic Ability, and learns the three formulas for inscribing a rune spell. Includes the Enchantment Runes sidebar.
quotes: (a Major Breakthrough requiring 45 breakthrough points), producing the new Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue, described below.
There are three ways to formulate a rune spell.

entries.title: Hermetic Rune Magic: Rune Duration and Inscription Target
entries.summary: The extended mechanic behind the Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue: the Rune Duration and Inscription Target, how and how fast runes are inscribed, casting-total modifiers for hiding or omitting the name and description, the craft-roll alternative, and the drawbacks (a lasting Arcane Connection and a Warping Point for the target).
quotes: This Duration is equivalent to Moon, adding three magnitudes to a spell's base level.
If the magus does not inscribe his name into the inscription, he receives a –5 penalty.

entries.title: Rune Magic and Creo Spells
entries.summary: Special rules for Creo with rune magic: created targets need the runes on an Arcane Connection to the target and are only created if it does not already exist, and healing runes take the place of natural healing while they remain on the target.
quotes: If the effect creates a target, the runes must be written on an Arcane Connection to that target, and the target is only created if it does not already exist.

entries.title: Unusual Amulets: Ib Scarab and Royal Names
entries.summary: The Ib Scarab replaces the heart and works at Personal Range, and seals with royal names carry a little Magic Resistance that may accidentally protect a wearer from curses.
quotes: it replaces the heart, and so can create effects at Personal Range.
These royal names have a little Magic Resistance, perhaps as high as 5 points.

entries.title: Temporary Objects From Models
entries.summary: Model objects in tombs can become temporary real objects with a faerie inside; troupes without Realms of Power: Faerie design it as a shapeshifting magic item.
quotes: Groups using only the core rules should design a magic item with a shapeshifting effect.

entries.title: Glamour
entries.summary: Glamours are Muto or Creo Imaginem spells that behave as real things; this covers how they are resisted by Magic Resistance, seen through with Second Sight, and the Vulnerable Magic Flaw gained on Initiation.
quotes: Merinitae always gain the Vulnerable Magic Flaw when they Initiate this Mystery.

entries.title: Spell Glamours
entries.summary: Glamours that change another's spell into a different spell, following the Muto Vim restrictions; useful as countermagic but socially risky.
quotes: must be fast-cast, and must penetrate the spell's Penetration Total

entries.title: The Golden Chain
entries.requires: Saga: the world after the Second Titanomachy
entries.summary: After the Titanomachy, Magic-aligned practitioners must connect to a being higher in the hierarchy of magic to fuel their powers. Describes the hierarchy, who keeps working, how a Gifted magus forms a pact with a patron (treated as an Initiation), and the cap the patron's Might places on Casting and Lab Totals.
quotes: The character's Casting Totals and Lab Totals cannot be higher than the Might of the creature with which one has made a pact
then the Target Ease Factor for the Initiation should be equal to two-thirds of the patron's Might
Only characters connected to this 'Golden Chain' can sequester the power necessary to fuel their spells.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Infernal p.124
Realms of Power: the Divine p.66

entries.title: All Bonds Break
entries.requires: Saga: the world after the Second Titanomachy
entries.summary: Rule changes after the Titans are freed: summonings, wards and banishments no longer work on Magic creatures higher on the Golden Chain than their originator, Perdo and Rego cannot defeat their Might, and familiar bonds with Magic-Might creatures are broken.
quotes: all summonings, wards, and banishments no longer work against Magic creatures that are higher up the Golden Chain than the originator of the effect

entries.title: Mutantum Magic (Metamagic)
entries.requires: Virtue: Mutantum Magic (or Boosted, Harnessed, Tethered Magic)
entries.summary: Rules for the three Mutantum metamagic effects: boosting a spell with vis to raise a parameter, harnessing it so it can be ended at will, and tethering it so control passes to another person or object.
quotes: By spending a pawn of vis when casting boosted spells or activating a boosted effect in an item, you may increase the Range, Duration, Target, or size of the effect by one magnitude.
Ritual spells cannot be tethered.

entries.title: Mutantum Spells (Requirements)
entries.requires: Boosted, Harnessed or Tethered Magic, or Mutantum Magic virtue
entries.summary: Explains that Mutantum spells have Boosted, Harnessed or Tethered qualities, each requiring a matching Virtue, and which Virtues allow formulaic versus spontaneous use.
quotes: Boosted: Requires Boosted Magic or Mutantum Magic

entries.title: Sensory Magic (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Sensory Magic (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Special Targets that affect anyone sensing the caster, with the restrictions on these spells (Personal Range, no Intellego, no investing) and a Lab Total bonus from the Heartbeast Ability for inventing them.
quotes: the magus's Heartbeast Ability score is added to the Lab Total

entries.title: Sensory Targets
entries.summary: Defines the five Sensory Targets (Flavor, Texture, Scent, Sound, Spectacle), how each works and its Hermetic Target size equivalent, and gives the Initiation Script for Sensory Magic.
quotes: The Flavor Target is equivalent to Individual.
The Texture Target is equivalent to Part.
The Scent Target is equivalent to Group.
The Sound Target is equivalent to Structure.

related.text: ArM5 p.83 Words and Gestures table

entries.title: Warding (Columbae)
entries.summary: The Columbae's Accelerated Ability for drawing chalk circles that ward away a subset of one Form. The Warding Total acts as a Casting Total for natural targets and as Penetration against beings with Might, but is useless against Magic Resistance without Might.
quotes: Warding Total: stress die + Stamina + Warding + aura
a ward against objects made of wood requires a Warding Total of at least 30

related.text: ArM5 p.114 Ring Duration / Circle Target

entries.title: Constantine's Visions: wards of Constantinople
entries.summary: Describes the two ancient Divine wards (Invocation/Cursing effects) that once protected the walls of Constantinople, now disabled, and what would be needed to restore them.
quotes: The Might of Faerie and Infernal creatures within the walls was reduced by 10, with a penetration of 20.
Invaders attempting to storm the walls suffered three additional botch dice on all stress rolls.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.70 (Sol Invictus)

entries.title: Animae Spell Guidelines
entries.summary: New Creo and Muto spell guidelines, organised by Form, for creating faeries or transforming things into them; the faerie's Might adds to the spell level.
quotes: Since all faeries have Might, and since their Might is added to the level of the spell, Animae spells must always be designed at a level greater than that given in the guidelines.

entries.title: Atlantean Magic (Range, Duration, Target)
entries.summary: Gives a Hermetic magus access to a special Range (Water-way), Duration (Storm) and Target (Body-of-water) usable in spontaneous, formulaic and ritual spells, with notes on how each is treated for spell level and on abuses of Storm duration.
quotes: For determining the spell level, waterway is the same range of effect as Sight.
For determining the spell level, Storm is the same duration as Concentration.
For determining the spell level, body-ofwater is the same level of Target as Structure

entries.title: New Aura Magic Guidelines (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of new Creo, Muto and Rego Vim guidelines for raising auras, changing the size of auras and regiones, closing regiones and linking regio levels; usable only in structural enchantments of Hermetic Architecture.
quotes: Increase the level of a Magical aura by +1 to a maximum of 9 — greatest increase possible
Double or halve the linear size of a Magical aura.

entries.title: Design and Inscription Bonuses
entries.summary: Enchantment bonuses from portraits, writing, seals or symbols and images that Craft Magic users can add to crafted effects and some lab work, in addition to shape and material bonuses.
quotes: Note that the total bonus gained from shape, material, design, and inscription is still limited to the magus's Magic Theory score (or an applicable Craft score)

entries.title: New Blessing Guideline
entries.summary: A new Blessing guideline that extends the beneficial effects of a relic to a group of men, targeting the relic rather than the men.
quotes: Level 15: Extend the beneficial effects of a relic over a standard Group of men.

entries.title: Limited Life-Time of Faerie Toys
entries.summary: Faerie toys are glamour and stop working after a fixed time, even charged items.
quotes: All the toys, therefore, only last for seven years after purchase.

entries.title: Figurine Magic
entries.summary: Procedure for crafting and enchanting short-lived wax or wood figurines for a single recipient, giving them a Minor Virtue or a Hermetic spell, with construction rolls, enchantment Ease Factors, and limits on which Virtues can be imbued.
quotes: Constructing a figurine takes a month for a wax figurine or two for a wood figurine.
Making a figure: Dexterity + Craft: Sculptor + Stress die
Enchanting a figure: Intelligence + Figurine Magic +Aura Modifier

entries.title: Identifying The Gift
entries.summary: How Hermetic Intellego Vim effects detect the Gift and hedge Arts or Supernatural Abilities, giving the effective residual magnitude of such a target.
quotes: an effective residual magnitude of his highest Art / 5
effective residual magnitude equal to his highest Supernatural Ability Score

entries.title: Instilling Magic Effects in Artwork
entries.requires: Maestro with Virtue: Hermetic Inclination in (Form)
entries.summary: Hermetic magi instill effects into artwork by the normal procedure, ignoring Aesthetic Quality. Maestros with Hermetic Inclination instead build the effect while making the piece, accumulating points from an Ability total against the effect level and paying Fatigue for higher-level effects.
quotes: the player compares his character's Dexterity + Craft Ability + Form to the final level of the effect
Instilling a magical effect in a piece of artwork costs a Fatigue Level per 10 levels of the spell-like power.

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

entries.title: Complexional Magic
entries.requires: Minor Breakthrough in Hermetic Theory (Corpus complexion magic)
entries.summary: Mentem can provoke the five emotional states, but directly changing or controlling a target's complexion and personality with Corpus would need a minor breakthrough and may induce symptoms of disease as a side effect.
quotes: This requires a Minor Breakthrough in Hermetic Theory

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.26-30

entries.title: The Mercere Portals
entries.requires: Mercere Portal access (Durenmar or other linked covenant)
entries.summary: Explains that Mercere Portals are permanent paired gateways with the effect of the ritual Hermes Portal, how Durenmar's are used and what visitors pay, and advises the storyguide how freely to allow long-range instant travel.
quotes: Each single Portal may only connect to one other, its matching pair.
all others are obliged to pay a fee of two pawns of vis each

entries.title: Nekuomanteioi: ghosts as Arcane Connections for necromantic divination
entries.summary: Stat block for the oracular ghosts of the basilica, with a necromancer rule at the end: using such a ghost as an Arcane Connection for Intellego spells to look into the past or future makes the spell a Ritual of higher magnitude and inflicts Warping.
quotes: This increases the magnitude of the spell by 4 if looking into the past, or 5 if looking into the hazy and indistinct future.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.49 Adjuration

entries.title: Opening Arts with Supernatural Abilities
entries.requires: Apprentice with a Supernatural Virtue or Ability
entries.summary: When a Gifted child has Supernatural Abilities, the parens needs a high enough Intellego Vim Lab Total to Open the Arts; meeting it destroys the Ability, doubling it keeps it, and the Ability can be converted into an Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: the parens' Intellego Vim Lab Total must equal or exceed 5 times the apprentice's score in any non-Hermetic Supernatural Ability
To maintain existing Supernatural Abilities, the Lab Total must double the necessary level.

entries.title: Parmulae
entries.summary: A lesser enchanted device giving its wearer fixed magic resistance for a limited time, with its construction cost, level of effect and limitations, plus a warning to discuss it with the troupe.
quotes: Parmulae: Lesser Enchanted Device that provides a magic resistance of 30. Total level of effect is 44.
Its base level of effect is Rego Vim 30.

entries.title: Perpetuity
entries.summary: Gives three ritual Durations (Might, aura, Hidden) that can last indefinitely under specified conditions.
quotes: All three are the same level as Year, and always require a ritual to cast.

entries.title: Bear Island: Waking or sleeping the titaness (Dindyméné ritual)
entries.summary: The dance and chant around the xoanon that wakes or puts to sleep the titaness, with an Ease Factor, bonuses for observing or including Daktyls, botch consequences, and a note on penetrating her Magic Resistance.
quotes: The player whose character is leading the dance must make a Faerie Lore + Communication + stress die against an Ease Factor of 18.
Faerie Lore + Communication + stress die vs. 18
Use the same formula if characters try to put Dindyméné to sleep, but increase the Ease Factor to 21.

entries.title: Significatos in the Cursewood (study from natural events)
entries.summary: Magical natural phenomena can be studied like vis, with the event substituting for pawns equal to the Might magnitude involved, limited to once per year each and one per season in this location.
quotes: Resolve this as vis study with the event substituting for a number of pawns of vis equal to the magnitude of Might of creatures involved.
Any individual Significato may only be studied once per year, and Wyzwanie allows the use of only one each season.

entries.title: Bear Island: The Xoanon of Dindyméné (pre-Hermetic artifact)
entries.summary: A Magic-realm effigy with three command-word powers, usable once per day each, that can be studied in a lab using the listed equivalent Hermetic Lab Totals.
quotes: Each of the xoanon's powers can be activated once per day.

entries.title: Saliva and Breath Ranges
entries.summary: Spitting or breathing on a target counts as a Range equivalent to Personal, but without bypassing Magic Resistance as Personal spells do, making some Spontaneous spells easier.
quotes: Treat this as equivalent to Personal range, but without circumventing Magic resistance as Personal spells do.
